Title: 1. Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi
description: After rescuing Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt, the Rebel Alliance attempts to destroy the second Death Star while Luke struggles to help Darth Vader back from the dark side.

Title: 2. Terms of Endearment
description: Widow Aurora Greenway juggles her own struggles with a new romantic interest while trying to sort out the emotional problems of her daughter who's married to a philandering husband.

Title: 3. Flashdance
description: An 18-year-old female amateur dancer who performs nightly at a dancing bar, and works as a welder during the day, dreams of joining the Pittsburgh ballet school.

Title: 4. Trading Places
description: A snobbish Wall Street commodities broker and a wily street hustler find their positions reversed as part of a bet by two callous millionaire brothers who run a brokerage house.

Title: 5. WarGames
description: A young teen boy finds a back door into a military central computer in which reality is confused with game-playing, possibly starting World War III.

Title: 6. Octopussy
description: A fake Fabergé egg recovered from the body of a fellow agent leads James Bond to uncover a jewel smuggling operation led by the mysterious Octopussy, and a plot to blow up a NATO air base.

Title: 7. Sudden Impact
description: When a woman exacts deadly revenge on the aggressors who raped her and her sister ten years earlier, Inspector "Dirty" Harry Callahan investigates the case.

Title: 8. Staying Alive
description: Five years later, Tony Manero's Saturday Night Fever is still burning. Now he's strutting toward his biggest challenge yet: succeeding as a dancer on the Broadway stage.

Title: 9. Mr. Mom
description: After he's suddenly laid off, a husband switches roles with his wife. She returns to the workforce, and he becomes a stay-at-home dad, and he has to take care of three young children, a job he has no clue how to do.

Title: 10. Risky Business
description: A Chicago teenager is looking for fun at home while his parents are away, but the situation quickly gets out of hand.

Title: 11. National Lampoon's Vacation
description: The Griswold family's cross-country drive in their brand new Wagon Family Truckster to the Walley World theme park in California proves to be much more arduous than they ever anticipated.

Title: 12. Superman III
description: Entrepreneur Ross Webster teams up with a computer genius in order to realise his own evil intentions. When Superman obstructs his plans, he decides to destroy him.

Title: 13. The Big Chill
description: A group of seven former college friends gather for a weekend reunion at a South Carolina vacation home after the funeral of another of their college friends.

Title: 14. Never Say Never Again
description: James Bond is called upon to try to recover nuclear bombs stolen by Spectre, but he will have to get rid of a professional assassin, hired especially to eliminate him.

Title: 15. Scarface
description: In the 1980s, a determined criminal-minded Cuban immigrant becomes the biggest drug smuggler in Miami, and is eventually undone by his own drug addiction.

Title: 16. Jaws 3-D
description: A giant thirty-five-foot shark becomes trapped in a SeaWorld theme park and it's up to the sons of police chief Brody to rescue everyone.

Title: 17. Blue Thunder
description: Rebellious Vietnam vet and police helicopter pilot Murphy, and his rookie partner, are assigned to test a cutting edge helicopter prototype. Murphy is surprised when the lead pilot turns out to be a fellow vet and personal nemesis.

Title: 18. Yentl
description: A Jewish girl disguises herself as a boy to enter religious training.

Title: 19. Silkwood
description: A worker at a plutonium processing plant is purposefully contaminated, psychologically tortured and possibly murdered to prevent her from exposing worker safety violations at the plant.

Title: 20. Psycho II
description: After twenty-two years of psychiatric care, Norman Bates attempts to return to a life of solitude, but the specters of his crimes - and his mother - continue to haunt him.

Title: 21. Porky's II: The Next Day
description: The naughty high schoolers of Angel Beach High now seek revenge on a group of KKK religious fanatics and corrupt politicians who want to shut down their Shakespeare production after they cast a Seminole transfer student in the lead.

Title: 22. Uncommon Valor
description: Ten years after his son went M.I.A. in Vietnam, U.S. Marine retired Colonel Jason Rhodes assembles a private rescue team to find Americans held in P.O.W. camps in Laos.

Title: 23. Never Cry Wolf
description: A government researcher, sent to research the "menace" of wolves in the north, learns about the true beneficial and positive nature of the species.

Title: 24. Twilight Zone: The Movie
description: Four horror and science fiction segments, directed by four famous directors, each of them being a new version of a classic story from Rod Serling's landmark television series.

Title: 25. Easy Money
description: To inherit his mother-in-law's colossal fortune, a hard-living gambling addict must change his unhealthy ways before they get the best of him.

Title: 26. High Road to China
description: Just after WW1, alcoholic American biplane pilot Patrick O'Malley is hired by Eve Tozer, the spoiled daughter of an industrialist, to locate her father, who disappeared somewhere in Asia.

Title: 27. The Outsiders
description: In Tulsa, Oklahoma in 1964, the rivalry between two gangs, the poor Greasers and the rich Socs, heats up when one gang member accidentally kills a member of the other.

Title: 28. Spring Break
description: Two sets of two college guys spend a spring break together in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. There they have lots of fun in and out of the sun.

Title: 29. Two of a Kind
description: When God decides to destroy Earth, four angels aim to redeem mankind through a young man and woman with their own troubles.

Title: 30. My Tutor
description: A rich father hires a tutor for his son. The son is a horny teenager and the tutor is a gorgeous blonde. Complications ensue.

Title: 31. Class
description: A naive high school senior meets a beautiful older woman, only to make a shocking discovery later on.

Title: 32. The Right Stuff
description: The U.S. space program's development from the breaking of the sound barrier to selection of the Mercury 7 astronauts, from a group of test pilots with a more seat-of-the-pants approach than the program's more cautious engineers preferred.

Title: 33. Cujo
description: Cujo, a friendly St. Bernard, contracts rabies and conducts a reign of terror on an American farm.

Title: 34. Christine
description: A nerdish boy buys a strange car with an evil mind of its own and his nature starts to change to reflect it.

Title: 35. A Christmas Story
description: In the 1940s, a young boy named Ralphie Parker attempts to convince his parents, teacher, and Santa Claus that a Red Ryder Range 200 Shot BB gun really is the perfect Christmas gift.

Title: 36. The Dead Zone
description: Five years after a traffic accident that left him in a coma, a man awakens to discover that he has the ability to foresee future events and even prevent tragedies from happening. Will these new abilities prove to be a blessing or a curse?

Title: 37. Breathless
description: When Jesse Lujack steals a car in Las Vegas and drives down to LA, his criminal ways only escalate - but when will it end?

Title: 38. Max Dugan Returns
description: Struggling single mother Nora McPhee's life is disrupted when her long-lost father Max Dugan returns in hopes of spending some time with her and her son Michael to make up for lost time because Max is dying.

Title: 39. Valley Girl
description: Julie, a girl from the valley, meets Randy, a punk from the city. They are from different worlds and find love. Somehow they need to stay together in spite of her trendy, shallow friends.

Title: 40. All the Right Moves
description: An ambitious young football star is trapped in a dying mill town--unless his gridiron skills can win him a way out.

Title: 41. Krull
description: A prince and a fellowship of companions set out to rescue his bride from a fortress of alien invaders who have arrived on their home planet, Krull.

Title: 42. Spacehunter: Adventures in the Forbidden Zone
description: On a distant planet inhabited by mutants, two bounty-hunters race to rescue three Earth female captives from the clutches of an evil mutant warlord.

Title: 43. D.C. Cab
description: The misadventures of a group of unfortunate but streetwise cabbies working for a Washington, D.C., decrepit taxicab company.

Title: 44. Gorky Park
description: A Moscow police officer investigates a vicious triple homicide and stumbles upon a high-level international political conspiracy.

Title: 45. Still Smokin
description: Cheech and Chong fly to the marijuana capital of the world, Amsterdam, for a film festival where they take Dolly Parton and Burt Reynolds' place in a limo, suite, press conference and performance. They throw in some sketches as well.

Title: 46. Monty Python's the Meaning of Life
description: The comedy team takes a look at life in all of its stages in their own uniquely silly way.

Title: 47. Educating Rita
description: An alcoholic professor has been hired by a working-class girl for higher education.

Title: 48. Private School
description: Chris from a girls' boarding school loves Jim from a nearby boys' boarding school. Jordan also wants Jim and plays dirty. Jim and two friends visit the girls' school posing as girls.

Title: 49. The Survivors
description: Having both lost their jobs, two strangers become unlikely friends after a run in with a would be robber, who is actually a hitman with a grudge against the two.

Title: 50. Revenge of the Ninja
description: After ninjas killed his family, Cho and his son Kane come to America to start a new life. He opens a doll shop but is unwittingly importing heroin in the dolls. When his friend betrays him, Cho must prepare for the ultimate battle.

Title: 51. To Be or Not to Be
description: At the onset of WW2, a Polish actor's family and the Polish Resistance help the troupe of a theatre escape Poland and the invading Nazis.

Title: 52. Stroker Ace
description: The title character, a popular NASCAR driver, clashes with the fried-chicken mogul that sponsors his racing team.

Title: 53. Lone Wolf McQuade
description: Texas Ranger J J McQuade works alone until a forced partnership and an arms smuggling case escalate after a personal attack draws him into a violent confrontation with Rawley Wilkes.

Title: 54. The Black Stallion Returns
description: A teenager loses his horse in Morocco and gets him back after various daredevil adventures.

Title: 55. Deathstalker
description: A lone warrior nicknamed Deathstalker is sent by a witch on a quest to find a sword, a chalice, and an amulet, two of which are held by the wicked king and sorcerer, Munkar.

Title: 56. Zelig
description: "Documentary" about a man who can look and act like whoever he's around, and meets various famous people.

Title: 57. The Lords of Discipline
description: In 1960s America, a black cadet is allowed acceptance into a seemingly prestigious military academy, unleashing a barrage of corruption within the system that another cadet is willing to expose.

Title: 58. The Man Who Loved Women
description: A womanizing sculptor named David goes to seek help from a psychiatrist, Marianna, to cure him of his obsession with women.

Title: 59. Hercules
description: The story of the Greek mythological figure Hercules, battling the wizard King Minos, who uses "science" in an attempt to take over the world. Hercules must stop him and rescue his princess love in the process.

Title: 60. Doctor Detroit
description: A pimp on the run trusts his prostitutes to a meek professor of literature, who accepts the challenge.

Title: 61. Deal of the Century
description: Small-time arms dealer Eddie Muntz visits South America to sell weapons to the revolutionaries and winds up negotiating the sale of an experimental plane to the nation's dictator.

Title: 62. The Man with Two Brains
description: A brain surgeon marries a femme fatale whose life he saved, causing his life to turn upside down. Things go even more awry when he falls in love with a telepathic brain.

Title: 63. Brainstorm
description: Researchers develop a system where they can jump into people's minds. But when people involved bring their personal problems into the equation, it becomes dangerous - perhaps deadly.

Title: 64. Lovesick
description: A psychiatrist, who falls in love with a patient, is visited by the spirit of Sigmund Freud, who gives him advice on how to handle it.

Title: 65. Without a Trace
description: Estranged New Yorker (Kate Nelligan) turns to the police after her son disappears.

Title: 66. Bad Boys
description: Chicago crime kid, Mick O'Brien, is sent to reform school after accidentally killing a rival's kid brother.

Title: 67. Strange Brew
description: Canada's most famous hosers, Bob and Doug McKenzie, get jobs at the Elsinore Brewery, only to learn that something is rotten with the state of it.

Title: 68. Tender Mercies
description: A broken-down, middle-aged country singer gets a new wife, reaches out to his long-lost daughter, and tries to put his troubled life back together.

Title: 69. Something Wicked This Way Comes
description: In a small American town, a diabolical circus and its demonic proprietor prey on the townsfolk. Dark's Pandemonium Carnival arrives in Green Town.

Title: 70. 10 to Midnight
description: A veteran LA detective becomes personally entangled in a serial killer case when the nude, knife-wielding suspect targets his daughter, forcing him to choose between the law and fatherly protection.

Title: 71. Romantic Comedy
description: A successful playwright employs a new female writing partner, and it's love on first sight, but it happens to be the day he gets married. They both suppress their feelings for each other in order to form a successful writing partnership.

Title: 72. Nightmares
description: Anthology of four horror tales with a supernatural twist based on urban legends.

Title: 73. The Golden Seal
description: A lonely 10-year-old boy living with his parents in a remote coastal part of Alaska, spontaneously finds a legendary golden seal and her newborn pup. But the greed for her valuable pelt sets off the hunters, including his own father, the local natives, and an ambitious poacher in pursuit the seal. The golden seal and her cub are hunted for a huge bounty on her head and the mythological legend.

Title: 74. The Osterman Weekend
description: During the Cold War, a controversial television journalist is asked by the C.I.A. to persuade certain acquaintances, who are Soviet Agents of the Omega network, to defect.

Title: 75. Star 80
description: A successful young model finds trouble when her obsessive manager-turned-husband becomes dangerously jealous.

Title: 76. The Sting II
description: A team of cons is planning a new scam involving betting on a boxing match but one of its past victims aims to exact revenge by eliminating the whole group.

Title: 77. Amityville 3-D
description: Inquisitive Reveal Magazine journalist John Baxter moves into the Amityville house in defiance of the supernatural events connected to it and finds everyone around him besieged by evil manifestations connected to a demonic presence.

Title: 78. Chained Heat
description: Young Carol Henderson ends up in prison, where she must learn how to survive in an environment plagued by violence, murder, rape, racism, drugs, and staff corruption and brutality.

Title: 79. Beyond the Limit
description: During the Dirty War, a half-English doctor in Argentina befriends the police, the rebels and the alcoholic Honorary British Consul, whose Latino wife he seduces. When the consul is mistakenly kidnapped by the rebels, he must pick a side.

Title: 80. The Hunger
description: A love triangle develops between a vampire, her cellist companion, and a gerontologist.

Title: 81. Local Hero
description: An American oil company has plans for a new refinery and sends someone to Scotland to buy up an entire village, but things don't go as expected.

Title: 82. Under Fire
description: Three journalists in a romantic triangle are involved in political intrigue during the last days of the corrupt Somoza regime in Nicaragua before it falls to a popular revolution in 1979.

Title: 83. Smokey and the Bandit Part 3
description: Big and Little Enos are opening a sea food restaurant. They bet Sheriff Buford T. Justice that he cannot drive from Miami to the Enos ranch in Texas in a given amount of time. If Buford loses he has to give up his badge.

Title: 84. A Night in Heaven
description: A married college professor begins a torrid affair with her failing student, who secretly moonlights as a late-night strip-club dancer.

Title: 85. The Star Chamber
description: Frustrated with a legal system gone haywire, a secret society of judges hires hitmen to snuff out criminals who escape courtroom justice - but one young judge questions the ethics of their vigilante system.

Title: 86. The Dresser
description: Personal assistant Norman struggles to get deteriorating veteran actor Sir through a difficult performance of King Lear.

Title: 87. Metalstorm: The Destruction of Jared-Syn
description: On a desert planet, warlord Jared-Syn is trying to convince a tribe of mutants that he's their messiah and gain unlimited power hidden in a crystal. Ranger Dogen and explorer Dhyana, whose father was murdered by Syn, must stop him.

Title: 88. Love Letters
description: A young woman obsessively retraces her deceased mother's emotional footsteps when love letters reveal a secret double life of love and infidelity.

Title: 89. Eddie and the Cruisers
description: A television newswoman picks up the story of a 1960s rock band whose long-lost leader Eddie Wilson may still be alive, while searching for the missing tapes of the band's never-released album.

Title: 90. Curse of the Pink Panther
description: Ensuing after the events of Clouseau's disappearance, his bosses at the Surete put a computer into service to elect a new shrewd detective, Sleigh, who turns up just as inept as Clouseau.

Title: 91. Trenchcoat
description: An aspiring mystery writer becomes accidently embroiled in an international plot during a two-week stay in Malta.

Title: 92. Yellowbeard
description: After serving two decades in prison, Yellowbeard (Graham Chapman) breaks out determined to recover the treasure that he buried so long ago, alongside his son, old crew, and the British Navy.

Title: 93. The Keep
description: Nazis are forced to turn to a Jewish historian for help in battling the ancient demon they have inadvertently freed from its prison.

Title: 94. Entre Nous
description: A Jewish refugee marries a soldier to escape deportation to Germany. Meanwhile a wealthy art student loses her first husband to a stray Resistance bullet; at the Liberation she meets an actor, gets pregnant, and marries him.

Title: 95. Joysticks
description: When a top local businessman and his two bumbling nephews try to shut down the town's only video arcade, which is run by the owner's grandson, the arcade employees and patrons fight back.

Title: 96. Running Brave
description: The story of Billy Mills, the American Indian who came from obscurity to win the 10,000-meter long-distance foot-race in the Tokyo Olympics in 1964.

Title: 97. Careful, He Might Hear You
description: After his mother's death, PS lives with working-class aunt and uncle until posh Aunt Vanessa claims co-guardianship. Happy with his simple life, he struggles with her upper-class expectations and custody battle.

Title: 98. Phar Lap
description: The true story of a New Zealand racehorse that became a champion, with the help of a local stable-boy.

Title: 99. Yor: The Hunter from the Future
description: A warrior seeks his true origins in a seemingly prehistoric wasteland.

Title: 100. Rumble Fish
description: An absent-minded street thug struggles to live up to his legendary older brother's reputation and longs for the days of gang warfare.

Title: 101. The Man Who Wasn't There
description: On his wedding day, a State Department employee is given an egg-shaped device by a dying man, with vials of liquid inside, which can turn people invisible. He finds himself being chased by various parties who want the substance.

Title: 102. Table for Five
description: J.P. Tannen takes his three children for a vacation cruise. They usually live with their mother and stepfather, but now J.P. feels capable of taking them. Emotional tragedy strikes, causing battles parent against parent, and parent against child. J.P. tries to show his children that he loves them.

Title: 103. Tough Enough
description: A C and W singer has a family to support so he boxes at a TOUGHMAN amateur boxing contest, hoping to win $5000 and maybe go on to the nationals and sing on national TV.

Title: 104. Man, Woman and Child
description: A man with a wife and two daughters learns that he has a son. It seems that a few years ago while visiting France, he had an accident and he had an affair with the doctor who treated him. Now he has learned that she just died and is informed of his son. He then tells his wife, she then suggest that they bring him over. While there all sorts of tension begin to arise. How will this affect them?

Title: 105. Merry Christmas Mr. Lawrence
description: During WWII, a British colonel tries to bridge the cultural divides between a British POW and the Japanese camp commander in order to avoid bloodshed.

Title: 106. Videodrome
description: A Toronto cable TV station co-owner who specializes in adult entertainment searches for the producers of a dangerous and bizarre broadcast titled "Videodrome."

Title: 107. Screwballs
description: Frolicking youth comedy about zany high school students set in the 1960s.

Title: 108. Testament
description: The life of a suburban American family is scarred after a nuclear attack.

Title: 109. Nate and Hayes
description: A swashbuckling pirate in late 1800s transports a young couple to a South Pacific island. After he leaves, they're attacked by his former partner, a nasty slaver, who kidnaps the young woman. Her fiancé partners with him to get her back.

Title: 110. Baby It's You
description: In a 1966 New Jersey high school, Jill and new student Sheik from the other side of the tracks make their way in a first love romance.

Title: 111. Exposed
description: Wisconsin farm girl Elizabeth Carlson leaves her family and her English-teacher lover behind, and escapes to New York City, where she soon makes a career for herself as a fashion model. During a private viewing of paintings, she is approached by a mysterious man whose motives are not clear.

Title: 112. Heat and Dust
description: Anne is investigating the life of her grand-aunt Olivia, whose destiny has always been shrouded with scandal. As Anne delves into the history of her grand-aunt, she is led to reconsider her own life.

Title: 113. Stryker
description: After the Apocalypse the world's water supply has dried up. A group of Amazons carefully guard one of the last freshwater springs. But marauding road warriors try to access the precious water – by any means necessary.

Title: 114. Get Crazy
description: Colin Beverly plans to sabotage the New Year's 1983 concert of small-time operator Max Wolfe. Wolfe's assistants Neil Allen and Willie Loman find romance while trying to save the drugs, violence, and rock and roll from Beverly's schemes.

Title: 115. Lianna
description: A happily married woman comes to realize herself of being a repressed lesbian after she has an affair with a female college professor, and then tries to come to terms with her newfound lifestyle.

Title: 116. Misunderstood
description: Busy and often absent father must take care of his two boys after his wife dies. They all live in Tunisia because of their father's job. The older boy is handling the difficult changes much better than the younger one.

Title: 117. Sahara
description: Intent on winning a competition in place of her distinguished late father, beautiful young heiress Dale takes on the guise of a man and competes in his spot, embarking on a car race that crosses the unforgiving Sahara desert.

Title: 118. Strange Invaders
description: Alien beings, who settle in a small midwestern town, are disturbed by a young professor determined to rescue his daughter from their clutches.

Title: 119. Gabriela
description: Gabriela becomes cook and mistress to Nacib, a bar owner in a small Brazilian coastal town controlled by local colonels, before eventually marrying him; based on Jorge Amado's novel.

Title: 120. Eddie Macon's Run
description: A young man, harshly sentenced for a few minor infractions, escapes from a prison in Huntsville Texas and flees to Laredo, Texas, where he hopes to cross into Mexico for a reunion with his wife and small son.

Title: 121. The Lonely Lady
description: Hoping to achieve success in Hollywood, a young aspiring screenwriter allows others to exploit her. She goes through affair after sordid affair in her attempt to write her own screenplay and have it produced.

Title: 122. Of Unknown Origin
description: A man becomes destructively obsessed with killing a dangerous rat, which has taken residence in his recently renovated house.

Title: 123. Getting It On
description: An ordinary sex-starved teenager and his friends start secretly video recording high school girls and their activity irks the community, as well as their principal.

Title: 124. Fire and Ice
description: At the end of the ice age, an evil queen and her son are set on conquering the world using magic and warriors. The lone survivor of a crushed village fights back as does the king of Fire Keep.

Title: 125. The Wicked Lady
description: A noblewoman grows restless with her privileged life and secretly takes to robbing travelers. She partners with a dashing highwayman, but her dangerous double life threatens to expose her true identity.

Title: 126. The Pirates of Penzance
description: After a young man leaves a band of pirates, hilarity ensues.

Title: 127. Daniel
description: Daniel Isaacson attempts to determine the true complicity of his parents Paul and Rochelle Isaacson, who were executed for espionage in the 1950s.

Title: 128. Streamers
description: Four young soldiers waiting to be shipped to Viet Nam deal with racial tension and their own intolerance when one soldier reveals he's gay.

Title: 129. Nostalgia
description: A Russian poet and his interpreter travel to Italy researching the life of an 18th-century composer, and instead meet a ruminative madman who tells the poet how the world may be saved.

Title: 130. Heart Like a Wheel
description: Shirley Muldowney is determined to be a top-fuel drag racer, although no woman has ever raced them before. Despite the high risks of this kind of racing and the burden it places on her family life, she perseveres in her dream.

Title: 131. Eureka
description: In 1925, a lone and obsessed Arctic prospector Jack McCann finally strikes gold. Twenty years later, he begins spiraling out of control when his only daughter becomes engaged to a man he strongly dislikes.

Title: 132. Slayground
description: Thieves run over a child while escaping after a robbery. A deadly hitman who likes to taunt his targets is hired to track them down. Stone moves to England, but the assassin follows. Loosely based on Donald Westlake's cult crime novel.

Title: 133. Sans Soleil
description: A woman narrates the contemplative writings of a seasoned world traveler, focusing on contemporary Japan.

Title: 134. Rock & Rule
description: A malevolent rock star kidnaps a singer to force her to participate in the summoning of a demon, and her band must help her stop him.

Title: 135. El Norte
description: After their family is killed in a government massacre, siblings Enrique and Rosa flee Guatemala and embark on a perilous journey to "El Norte."

Title: 136. My Brother's Wedding
description: A man who has struggled personally has conflicts with his upwardly mobile lawyer brother and his brother's well to-do fiancée and is reluctant to be the best man at their wedding.

Title: 137. Summerspell
description: Family celebrations and tensions, Independence Day, Texas 1948

Title: 138. Confidentially Yours
description: After he's implicated in several murders, a real estate agent hides out from the cops while his intrepid secretary does some private investigating of her own to locate the killer.

Title: 139. Sleepaway Camp
description: Bunks and showers are a mad stabber's beat at a summer camp strictly for teens.

Title: 140. A Caribbean Mystery
description: While Miss Marple is on vacation in a luxurious Caribbean resort, a fellow guest confides he has evidence that another resident of the hotel is an unscrupulous serial murderer but is poisoned before he can reveal his identity to her.

Title: 141. Angst
description: A troubled man gets released from prison and starts taking out his sadistic fantasies on an unsuspecting family living in a secluded house.

Title: 142. Barefoot Gen
description: A powerful statement against war, Barefoot Gen is a disturbing story about the effect of the atomic bomb on a boy's life and the lives of the Japanese people.

Title: 143. The Key
description: 1940s Venice. After twenty years of marriage, a retired art critic and his younger wife feel their passion is waning. To help her shed her inhibitions and rekindle their relationship, the professor records his sexual fantasies in a diary.

Title: 144. The Ballad of Narayama
description: In a poor 19th century rural Japanese village, everyone who reaches the age of 70 has to climb a nearby mountain to die. An elderly woman is reaching close to her cut-off age during her last days with her family.

Title: 145. L'Argent
description: A counterfeit bill that starts off as a schoolboy prank leads to incarceration and violence.

Title: 146. The 4th Man
description: A man who has been having visions of an impending danger begins an affair with a woman who may lead him to his doom.

Title: 147. Cucaracha
description: A policeman is torn between doing his job, following his code of honor and being dedicated to his love interest.

Title: 148. First Desires
description: Three teenage girls decide to visit a romantic island and find love. They get shipwrecked and end up on different sides of the island. Each girl begins her own romantic adventure either with a man, a boy or even another girl.

Title: 149. Suburbia
description: When household tensions and a sense of worthlessness overcome Evan, he finds escape when he hangs with the orphans of a throwaway society.

Title: 150. Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro
description: Two photographers, who are employed by a magazine editor to expose the scandalous activities of the rich, come across corruption by a builder and accidentally photograph a murder.

Title: 151. The Lift
description: A lift technician finds himself drawn into a web of mystery and peril as he investigates the perplexing deadly accidents occurring in the elevators of a new office building.

Title: 152. Project A
description: Fighting against pirates at the turn of the 20th century, the Hong Kong navy are failing miserably. It's up to Sergeant Dragon Ma to take matters into his own hands.

Title: 153. Danton
description: In 1793, as the Terror begins in France, Georges Danton, a champion-of-the-people, returns to clash against Maximilien Robespierre and his extremist party.

Title: 154. Doraemon: Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
description: Doraemon suggests going on an underwater adventure for a summer vacation, and they find a underwater civilization that doesn't have contact with surface nations.

Title: 155. El Sur
description: A woman reflects on her childhood relationship with her father, attempting to understand the depths of his despair and the truth of his myths.

Title: 156. Heroic Times
description: The tragic medieval tale of a man of inhuman strength, fierce temper and a desire for noble knighthood. While on the run as a murderer, he finds new life as a knight, only to face disillusionment, the horrors of war and ugly human vices.

Title: 157. The Last Battle
description: In a post-apocalyptic future where no one is able to speak, the few remaining humans fight over resources in order to survive.

Title: 158. Born in Flames
description: Set ten years after the most peaceful revolution in United States history, it presents a dystopia in which the issues of many groups - minorities, liberals, gay rights organizations, feminists - are dealt with by the government.

Title: 159. Masoom
description: A happy family goes through turbulent times because of a big mistake by one of the family members.

Title: 160. The Ship Sails On
description: In 1914, a luxury ship leaves Italy in order to scatter the ashes of a famous opera singer. A lovable bumbling journalist chronicles the voyage and meets the singer's many eccentric friends and admirers.

Title: 161. The Boys from Fengkuei
description: Ah-Ching and his friends have just finished school in their island fishing village, and now spend most of their time drinking and fighting. Three of them decide to go to the port city of Kaohsiung to look for work. They find an apartment through relatives, and Ah-Ching is attracted to the girlfriend of a neighbor. There they face the harsh realities of the big city.

Title: 162. Pauline at the Beach
description: Marion is about to divorce from her husband and takes her 15-year-old niece Pauline on a vacation to Granville. She meets an old love...

Title: 163. Cries of Pleasure
description: A married man invites a woman to his house to live with him, just before the arrival of his wife, who is coming back from a mental asylum.

Title: 164. Nana

description: It's New Year's Eve. Larry throws a party at his parents' home while they're out. Unbeknownst to his parents, all of Larry's friends and local police attend the unauthorized celebration.

Title: 319. Beauty and the Beast
description: In Århus, Denmark, mom's in hospital, pregnant, while dad and 16 y.o.daughter are spending time together painting the baby room. Dad can't accept that his daughter has grown up with interest in guys etc. Instead, he turns to spying on her.

Title: 320. The Wounded Man
description: A young man discovers his homosexuality and begins a relationship with a manipulative hustler / petty criminal that he meets at a train station.

Title: 321. Triumphs of a Man Called Horse
description: When gold is found on Sioux lands, crooked men attempt to provoke the Sioux into a war with the army and the prospectors.

Title: 322. Savage Attraction
description: Horrific true tale set in late-1970s Australia and later West Germany about an abused wife who learns in horror that her sadistic German-born husband is actually a fanatical neo-Nazi.

Title: 323. Fantasy Mission Force
description: A force of loners and fighters is put together to try and rescue Generals that are captured by the Japanese and save the war effort with the promise of gold and/or pardons of past crimes.

Title: 324. Femmes
description: Helmut is fed up traveling around he world. Coming back from Asia, he decides to stay some time in Alexandra's house, a long time friend. She is living on a beautiful island where she is doing art.

Title: 325. Utu
description: In 1870, a Maori warrior working with the British finds his village massacred, and vows revenge.

Title: 326. Atlantis Interceptors
description: An ancient Atlantean relic is discovered on the ocean floor near a sunken nuclear submarine, which triggers a violent set of events that sees a couple of scientists teaming up with a few mercenaries to survive the onslaught that follows.

Title: 327. Thieves and Robbers
description: A playboy who makes a living out of seducing women and stealing their jewellery accidentally witnesses a Mafia murder. He must work together with the man who is constantly trying to catch him, Lt. Alan Parker, in order to save his life.

Title: 328. Segni particolari: bellissimo
description: Mattia is a nice guy, famous writer, who is about to marry Rosalie. Mattia, the day before the wedding, goes to confession to the priest, and reveals that he is in love with another woman, younger, named Michela.

Title: 329. She Cat
description: Cat Kagami tries leaving her troubled past, but a botched assassination puts her in brutal killers' sights. Her co-worker and a woman with a company-threatening secret are endangered. Cat seeks revenge.

Title: 330. Mountaintop Motel Massacre
description: A mentally-unstable elderly woman recently released from a mental asylum proceeds to slaughter all the guests staying at her motel.

Title: 331. Günesin Tutuldugu Gün
description: Sevgi is cashier at a market. She wants gracious living. One day she abducted and rape. After this event Sevgi's life will totally change.

Title: 332. American Nightmare
description: A man investigates the disappearance of his sister with the help of her roommate. He uncovers a trail of prostitution, incest, blackmail...and murder.

Title: 333. Village of Doom
description: An emotionally distraught young man goes on a violent killing spree after his tuberculosis keeps him from serving in World War II and is frowned upon by his fellow villagers.

Title: 334. A Brutal Game
description: A strict father imposes impossible guidelines on his disabled daughter which reflect his secret, tortured life.

Title: 335. Angel of H.E.A.T.
description: A mad scientist uses an army of androids and a device that can disintegrate metal to try to steal microchips containing top secret information. The government dispatches a beautiful female agent to stop him.

Title: 336. The Makioka Sisters
description: The orphaned Makioka sisters look for a husband for their third sister, Yukiko, as the rebellious youngest sister, Taeko, is kept waiting her turn.

Title: 337. The Ploughman's Lunch
description: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

Title: 338. Mandi
description: Forbidden love, fraying loyalties and flagrant hypocrisy emerge when sanctimonious politicians drive a madam's brothel from the heart of Hyderabad.

Title: 339. Thunder
description: A native American named Thunder returns home only to find that his ancestral burial ground is being destroyed by construction workers. He tries to put a stop to it, but the law is not only not on his side, but he is banished from town, beaten up, and left for dead. Now he wants his revenge.

Title: 340. Farewell
description: Matyora is a small village on a beautiful island with the same name. The existence of the village is threatened with flooding by the construction of a dam. This is the story of the inhabitants of Matyora and their farewell to their homeland.

Title: 341. Betaab
description: A young man (Sunny Deol) and woman (Amrita Singh) fall in love, but face obstacles from their families.

Title: 342. Rio Babilonia
description: Public relations man is invited to guide American millionaire during his stay in Rio de Janeiro. In this course, he gets involved in the most bizarre situations, from orgiastic mega-parties and sexy ménages-a-trois to confrontations with the police, meetings with drug dealers and movie stars, facing corruption and even murder.

Title: 343. The Wall
description: Teens in a Turkish prison struggle to survive under hideous conditions.

Title: 344. God's Crooked Lines
description: Detective Alicia Gould, investigating the murder of a client's father, decides to go undercover to an asylum.

Title: 345. Attacked Female Teacher
description: A woman who experienced rape in school and broke up with her lover, becomes a high school music teacher, but finds a turning point when she encounters her old lover.

Title: 346. Paano ba ang mangarap?
description: A young woman suffers such great difficulties in life that she has forgotten how to dream.

Title: 347. Code of Hunting
description: A pacifist lawyer's husband is accidentally killed during a home invasion. One of the culprits is caught, and his deranged brother begins to threaten the lawyer that if his brother isn't released, he will violently retaliate.

Title: 348. Forbidden Relations
description: Juli and Gyorgy, half-brother and half-sister, fall in love and become lovers. Juli becomes pregnant and Gyorgy is sentenced to jail for their illegal relationship. But their love only intensifies as they stand together against the world.

Title: 349. Corpo e Alma de Mulher
description: A young couple, Rodrigo and Aimé, who love each other deeply and possess everything to achieve full happiness, are hit by fate: She suffers an accident and becomes paralyzed.

Title: 350. Bastard Swordsman
description: Hsu Shao-chiang stars as a veritable "Spider-Swordsman" - master of the "Silkworm Style" - in this eye-filling, mind-bending martial arts phantasmagorical which truly warrants the description: "unforgettable."

Title: 351. Boogeyman II
description: Lacey travels to Hollywood, to the home of a film director, where she brings along the last surviving haunted mirror shard from the end of the first movie as proof to her horrifying experiences.

Title: 352. The Family Game
description: Japanese parents hire a tutor for their foolish son and get a critic of their lifestyle.

Title: 353. Gramps Is in the Resistance
description: Bourdelle, a family of musicians, refuse to play for Germans during the war. They would like to liberate France using all possible means.

Title: 354. Hero
description: After his boss is imprisoned, a goon kidnaps the daughter of the police commissioner but soon falls in love with her and vows to reform his ways.

Title: 355. The Revolt of Job
description: An elderly Jewish couple, adopt an unruly non-Jewish child to whom they intend to pass on their wealth and knowledge before Nazi oppression engulfs Hungary.

Title: 356. Stacy's Knights
description: Two young gamblers are on a non-stop roll, but soon the casino wants to even the odds and bring their winning streak to a close.

Title: 357. Hong Kong, Hong Kong
description: A story of the illegal immigrant experience of people from the mainland of China who have made it to Hong Kong for a better life.

Title: 358. I Married a Shadow
description: After a train accident, a woman survives and is mistaken for an other woman she just met on a train before the accident.

Title: 359. A Woman in Flames
description: Eva leaves her husband, becomes a call girl, and falls for Chris, a fellow escort, with whom she shares a penthouse.

Title: 361. Harmagedon
description: A Transylvanian princess, a Japanese student and a centuries-old cyborg join a small group of psionic warriors to defend Earth against an alien entity bent on total cosmic destruction.

Title: 362. Mahaan
description: A lawyer goes into hiding after being falsely accused of committing a crime while his wife gives birth to twins. One of the twins is separated at birth, while the other twin grows up to become an inspector who is on his father's trail.

Title: 363. Can She Bake a Cherry Pie?
description: Zee (Karen Black) is walking up and down Manhattan streets, talking to herself and to the husband who just left her. At a sidewalk café she runs into Eli (Michael Emil). A very unlikely, funny, and touching relationship develops between two lost souls in the big city, which is the third major character in this film.

Title: 364. Bill Cosby: Himself
description: A concert film in which Bill Cosby discusses weekends, raising children, dentists, and many other situations.

Title: 365. Fearless Hyena 2
description: A pair of evil kung-fu artists, Heaven and Earth, are slaughtering the entire Yin-Yang brotherhood. The movie opens with two members of the brotherhood and their two male children being chased by Heaven, Earth, and miscellaneous bad guys. The two members get away separately with their children. Twenty years later, we see Chan Lung (Jackie Chan) as he hunts frogs and snakes and keeps them in his pants. You learn he was one of the boys. The other is a lazy man who uses windmill-driven levers to deliver things to and from bedside, even a chamberpot and breakfast. Eventually, their respective paternal figures are killed, and they are forced to fight Heaven and Earth.

Title: 366. The Beast and the Magic Sword
description: In the 16th century, lycanthrope Waldemar Daninsky travels from his native Europe to Japan, seeking a way to cure himself of being a werewolf. Only a Japanese sorcerer named Kian and a magic silver sword can save him.

Title: 367. Utilities
description: Bob Hunt is a put upon social worker who has had enough of the bad service of public utilities. He decides to organize resitance to the phone, gas and water monopolies but also wants to impress policewoman Marion Edwards.

Title: 368. Young Warriors
description: A young woman is gang raped and murdered in a California college town, sparking her brother Kevin to take up arms by night with a gang of like-minded vigilantes from his fraternity, brutally punishing any miscreants they catch in a criminal act. In the meantime, Kevin debates the issue of violent crime in the U.S. with his teachers and others during the day. As Kevin and his gang head toward a final, bloody confrontation with the low-lifes who murdered his sister, other scenes show the difference between his character, now violent, and the normal people he is supposedly protecting.

Title: 369. Spring Symphony
description: Chronicles the illustrious 19th-century love affair between composer Robert Schumann and pianist Clara Wieck.

Title: 370. Hells Angels Forever
description: What starts off as a squadron of American daredevil bombers in World War II, branded by society as renegades, turns into a revealing ride into the world of honor, violence, and undying passion for motorcycles on the road.

Title: 371. Sunshine Reggae auf Ibiza
description: Simple farmer Karl takes a plane to Ibiza, determined to finally meet pop-singer Lina. At the same time however, a famous millionaire, who happens to look just like Karl, is staying on the island as well.

Title: 372. Mar brava
description: Mingo, a kid whose father and brother have disappeared in shipwrecks, finds an amnesic man lying on the beach. Might he be St. Elmo?

Title: 373. A Night to Dismember
description: A woman from a "cursed" family is released from a mental facility, and soon dismembered corpses start turning up.

Title: 374. A Polish Vampire in Burbank
description: A somewhat reluctant vampire is taken out by his sexpot sister for his first "night out on the town."

Title: 375. Angkinin mo ako
description: A YOUNG WOMAN DESPERATELY LONG INTIMACY.

Title: 376. Hot Panties
description: A group of boys and girls who are having fun in a discotheque are invited to a villa where some crazy people make them spend a very bad time.

Title: 377. The Erotic and Wacky Tunnel of Time
description: Young nerdy and horny Perico invents a time machine and uses it for sex tourism. He visits the cavewomen, ancient Egypt, ancient Rome and a Turkish harem, but also the future. However, his real test is in the present.

Title: 378. Sugar Cane Alley
description: Set in 1931, Sugar Cane Alley paints a rich impasto of native life under French colonial rules, filtered through the coming-of-age of a bright, sweetly opportunistic boy.

Title: 379. Secrets
description: Teen girl in 1963 finds freemasonry items in her late fathers briefcase including condoms and a book of rites. The book is taken to school and the girls form their own club. The mother finds the condoms and makes wrong assumption.

Title: 380. Strangers Kiss
description: Hollywood mogul funds low-budget film to boost girlfriend's confidence. First-time producer/director duo create promising project despite constraints. Actress develops chemistry with unknown male lead during filming.

Title: 381. Somewhere, Tomorrow
description: When a teenage girl witnesses a plane crash, she talks with one of the injured passengers...only to find out he was actually killed in the accident.

Title: 382. Sugar Pie Lady
description: In the harsh times of the small time crime in Istanbul, a conscientious police officer Cumali is recognized by the police chief Ziver Bey who sees Cumali as a threat and matches him with Sekerpare, a famous harlot.

Title: 383. I Am the Cheese
description: A teenage lad struggles to piece together his reality following a traumatic event.

Title: 384. Morbus
description: A scientist has discovered a formula that brings the dead back to life. Meanwhile, a prostitute, who dreams of writing a book in a brothel, meets a true writer with whom she falls in love. A satanic sect will cross into their lives.

Title: 385. Andhaa Kaanoon
description: Two siblings attempt to avenge the death of their father and elder sister. But the sister believes in the law while the brother believes in administering justice himself.

Title: 386. Keep Waiting for Me
description: A man recalls 1950s Argentina, his childhood neighborhood and family store. Despite Perón-era political divisions, community bonds remained strong. It's between child and adult views, using newsreels and Evita's funeral footage.

Title: 387. Lucky Luke: The Daltons on the Run
description: Three episodes of the Lucky Luke animated series compiled into one movie. Cool gunslinger Lucky Luke goes after the Dalton gang in "The Daltons in the Blizzard", "Ma Dalton" and "The Daltons Redeem Themselves".

Title: 388. A Railway Station for Two
description: A waitress from the provincial railway station falls in love with an accidental passenger. Before this passenger lies the menace of distant prison for the crime he didn't commit.

Title: 389. Urusei Yatsura: Only You
description: A mysterious and powerful alien girl, Elle, sends invitations to all of Ataru's friends to attend her wedding ceremony to non other than Ataru himself, to the surprise of everyone, and to the rage of Lum, Ataru's possessive alien lover.

Title: 390. Carne de tu carne
description: When grandmother dies, a girl returns to Colombia from the US and is reunited with her half-brother. They are instantly attracted to each other and have delirious visions of ancestors who also starred in stories of incest and violence.

Title: 391. Lady Tarzan
description: Raised by compassionate wild animals as one of their own, a helpless eight-year-old girl grows into a beautiful, untamed woman and becomes Lady Tarzan: the fearless Queen of the Elephants.

Title: 392. Coquette
description: Two teenagers fall in love with each other for the first time.

Title: 393. Le battant
description: Jacques Darnay exits prison after 10 years for a jewel robbery with missing diamonds. The jeweler's death is unresolved. Police, former accomplices investigate while Darnay conceals his motives.

Title: 394. Panic Beats
description: A wealthy architect takes his ailing wife to an ancestral estate for recovery, where frightening visions and an old family legend begin turning their secluded refuge into something far more sinister.

Title: 395. Doosri Dulhan
description: Renu and her husband, Anil, are devastated when she cannot bear children after a miscarriage. But soon, he visits a brothel and asks young Chanda to carry and give birth to a baby for his family.

Title: 396. The Throne of Fire
description: A mighty hero battles the son of Satan and his evil witch ally to save a kingdom from being taken over by the duo.

Title: 397. Chile picante
description: Two love stories where sex is a character as spicy as the chili itself. The stories are: La Infidelidad and Los Compadres.

Title: 398. The Demons of Ludlow
description: A murderous demon lurks inside an antique piano in a picturesque coastal town.

Title: 399. Amagi Pass
description: Japan in the 1940s. A high school boy went into a magic encounter with Ozuka Hana, a geisha (pub-girl) when he traveled through Amagi Pass. A mysterious murder took place afterwards, an Ozuka was held responsible. 40 years later, the boy, who became a printing shop owner, was visited by a retired policeman who came from Amagi Pass. The truth then started to reveal itself.

Title: 400. The Wild Duck
description: A loving family's world is shattered by an old friend's arrival, carrying a dark secret.

Title: 401. Blue Mountains, or Unbelievable Story
description: An author - a passive young man - enters the Soviet-controlled bureaucracy of Georgia attempting to get his novel published only to be neglected and compartmentalized at every turn.

Title: 402. Tokyo Trial
description: Documentary covering the 1946-48 Tokyo Trials.

Title: 403. Burroughs: The Movie
description: Burroughs: The Movie explores the life and times of controversial Naked Lunch author William S. Burroughs, with an intimacy never before seen and never repeated. The film charts the development of Burroughs' unique literary style and his wildly unconventional life, including his travels from the American Midwest to North Africa and several personal tragedies. Burroughs: The Movie is the first and only feature length documentary to be made with and about Burroughs. The film was directed by the late Howard Brookner. It was begun in 1978 as Brookner's senior thesis at NYU film school and then expanded into a feature which was completed 5 years later in 1983. Sound was recorded by Jim Jarmusch and the film was shot by Tom DiCillo, fellow NYU classmates and both very close friends of Brookner's.

Title: 404. Fantozzi Succumbs Again
description: After a hard day at work and a condominium-board meeting, accountant Ugo Fantozzi goes on a trip with his family. Unfortunately, he will face a nasty surprise upon his return.

Title: 405. The Funny Farm
description: Welcome to the comedy club where young comics make every night riot night. Now, they're taking their act to the streets.

Title: 406. Gulliver's Travels
description: Gulliver washes ashore on Brobdingnag and becomes an object of curiosity for its gigantic inhabitants.

Title: 407. Baby Cat
description: The life of a Parisian photo model turns into a nightmare when the photographer with whom she used to work begins to pursue her constantly but she refuses his offers.

Title: 408. Erendira
description: While Erendira, a beautiful teenage girl, has a surreal mystical vision, her grandmother's house catches on fire and burns to the ground. Her grandmother holds Erendira responsible and, in order to extract restitution from the girl, forces her into prostitution. Erendira's surreal mystical experiences continue while her grandmother grows rich from exploiting her.

Title: 409. Agítese antes de usarla
description: Two apprentice scammers who meet in a clinic on the Costa del Sol. By running the clinic they want to advertise. So they take advantage of the arrival of a deputy to cast him unnecessarily, waiting for the arrival of television cameras.

Title: 410. Skullduggery
description: A 1980s classic in which a game of "Dungeons and Dragons" is the centerpiece of a mystery. Adam happens to come from a long line of cursed men; he succumbs to the curse and goes on a killing spree.

Title: 411. State buoni se potete
description: The Italian priest Filippo Neri helps street children and orphans in 16th-century Rome by teaching them good versus evil, but he clashes with both the conventional church and the devil, who tries to corrupt the youths.

Title: 412. The Last Blood
description: During the Vietnam war, an army sergeant rebels against his tyrant commanding officer, whilst they are cut off by the enemy in the jungle. Things get worse for all of them after that.

Title: 413. The Boys in Blue
description: In Little Botham, policemen Cannon and Ball stage fake crimes to avoid station closure. They accidentally encounter real art thieves, leading to a chaotic confrontation involving the stolen artworks.

Title: 414. Razia Sultan
description: An account of the reign of Indian empress Razia Sultan and her love for her slave Jamaluddin Yakut.

Title: 415. Souten
description: Shyam, a middle-class man, falls in love with a millionaire's daughter and marries her. However, as their relationship starts deteriorating, Shyam finds solace in the company of Radha.

Title: 416. Avtaar
description: Avtaar Krishen lives a poor lifestyle with his wife, Radha, and two sons, Ramesh and Chander. He works in a factory and toils hard so that his sons can get the necessary education, and live a better lifestyle. He gets injured and crippled while working, but is compensated adequately by his employer, Bawaji. Years later his sons have grown up. While Ramesh has married Sudha and works with a bank; Chander is wooing Renu, the only daughter of wealthy Seth Laxminarayan. When Avtaar and Radha wish to go on a tirathyatra (pilgrimage), they ask Ramesh to book tickets for them, but he tells them that he has no money. When Radha gets sick, their servant, Sewak, enters Sudha's room to get some money for her treatment, as a result Radha does get treatment, but Sudha blames them for stealing her money. Avtaar asks Ramesh and his wife to get out, only to find out that the house is now in Sudha's name. AVtaar, Radha and Sewak move out and live in a shanty hut. Their hopes are with Chander, who does well in his exams, decides to marry Renu, and moves out without financially assisting his parents. Now Avtaar and Radha are elderly and dependent on Sewak, and the question remains will they resign themselves to this existence, if not, what possibly can a crippled older male accomplish, especially at this time in his life?

Title: 417. Killing of the Flesh
description: A murder occurs at a hotel where a phalanx of frisky funeral-goers are staying. Ordered by the police to stay to see if the killer will strike again, the guests get even friskier with one another.

Title: 418. Master of the World
description: Primitive humans had to adapt to their brutal and savage environment or disappear into oblivion. For Bog, a great warrior, this struggle means conquering the land and gaining supremacy over his rivals.

Title: 419. Cross Country
description: After a woman is found butchered in her New York apartment, suspicion falls on her estranged husband, an ad executive who has suddenly left town on a cross-country road trip. He takes along a beautiful girl he met in a bar and a drifter he picked up along the way. A cop sets out after the husband, but he's more interested in shaking him down than bringing him back.

Title: 420. Scalps
description: A group of archeological students venture on Indian land for a dig. Unfortunately, they release an evil spirit who possesses one of them and starts killing the others.

Title: 421. Mad Mission Part 2: Aces Go Places
description: Black Gloves (Joe Dimmick), a European Assassin, is seeking to avenge his brother White Gloves' death against reformed criminal King Kong (Samuel Hui) and Detective Albert "Baldy" Au (Karl Maka). While evading Black Gloves, the duo are framed for robberies by Hong Kong Mafia members, who have their own plans against King Kong and Baldy. The duo is forced to deal with the Mafia's motor bike gangsters and Black Glove's weaponry-laden robot.

Title: 422. Caged Fury
description: North American and Asian women are brainwashed into becoming suicide bombers in an evil Filipino POW camp

Title: 423. La casa del tappeto giallo
description: Franca and her husband Antonio decide to sell a yellow rug, which was a gift of Franca's stepfather. One day, while Antonio is out, a strange man rings, saying he wishes to buy the rug. But the man's visit becomes a nightmare. He kidnaps Franca and says he killed his wife on that same yellow rug. Then Franca kills the man. But is that really all that has happened? And who was that strange man?

Title: 424. Toxic Love
description: The alienating and repetitive life of a group of heroin junkies in the 1980s Rome.

Title: 425. El día del compadre
description: The inhabitants of a condominium are having a wild party.

Title: 426. In the White City
description: A Swiss sailor abandons his post during a stopover in Lisbon and takes up residence in a small hotel in the city.

Title: 427. Equator
description: Novel-based crime drama about naive Timar, who goes to Gabon, French Equatorial Africa in the 1950s with dreams of making fortune. He's seduced by Adele, a shady owner of a local hotel, Libreville, who uses him to commit murder.

Title: 428. Men from the Gutter
description: A desperate ex-con plans a robbery with his woman and two former cell mates. Meanwhile, a man is determined to kill a treacherous drug kingpin no matter the cost. Two cops with differing ideals pursue the criminals.

Title: 429. L'été de nos quinze ans
description: It was during their childhood that François and Malène became friends. Years later, the two teenagers find themselves. Their parents, moved by their reunion, will help them not to spoil this new chance.

Title: 430. Botas negras, látigo de cuero
description: Al Pereira is hired by a married woman to retrieve compromising photos .

Title: 431. The Bleeder
description: On tour through Sweden, the all-girl rock 'n' roll band "Rock Cats" suddenly find themselves trapped in no-man's land when their tour-bus breaks down. Soon they get to meet "the Bleeder", an insane beast of a man whose sole interest is to kill them all off, one by one. The hunt is on...

Title: 432. Lesbians in Uniforms
description: Two high school girls discover the pleasure of sex with each other until one of them chooses to be with a boy.

Title: 434. Otto er et næsehorn
description: While out playing with his friend, Viggo, Topper comes across a magical pencil. When he draws a fish, it comes alive. When he draws a rhino on a 3rd floor wall, it comes alive, too. The boys name him Otto, like Viggo's dad.

Title: 435. Beauty Rope Cosmetology
description: Miki is the daughter of an affluent family. She's an elegant and sophisticated girl who gets captured by a secret admirer.

Title: 436. Deadline Auto Theft
description: After an attempted theft of his daughter's husband's car, LAPD Captain Gibbs declares war on master car thief Maindrian Pace - overtaking his boss' betrayal and pursuing the Eleanor as Pace tries to make his getaway.

Title: 437. For Those I Loved
description: A story of the life of a Polish Jewish Holocaust survivor.

Title: 438. Deadly Force
description: When a friend's daughter gets killed, a former police detective returns to Los Angeles as a private detective and vigilante to catch a serial killer, while trying to rekindle his relationship with his estranged wife.

Title: 439. Zaman
description: An undercover inspector of the Antwerp criminal investigation unit faces problems not only in his professional life, but also at home. When he is partnered with a young, over-confident colleague, he loses control over the case in hand, a situation that further takes its toll on his marriage. He's forced to ask himself whether his job is an addiction, a hunt for people that becomes more exciting the shrewder his opponent is.

Title: 440. Dark Room
description: Nakata, a writer grappling with his wife's death, abandons marriage and fatherhood to escape guilt. He embarks on a sexual journey, resulting in a philosophical essay, "The Dark Room," on sexuality and mankind's fate.

Title: 441. Shaolin Intruders
description: The Shaolin Temple becomes prime suspect when a few martial arts clans begin to be violently killed. With the deadly Shaolin Palm technique as their only evidence, three heroes set out to identify the culprits, but nothing is as it seems.

Title: 442. The Prodigal
description: Greg Stuart is unhappy with his middle-class family and their Christian values. In an attempt to estrange himself from the life he knows, he ends up in a spiral of confusing and troubling events.

Title: 443. Foxfire Light
description: A spoiled rich girl used to getting her way comes up against a rancher who won't be intimidated by her.

Title: 444. Carnival Magic
description: A carnival magician with actual magic powers works with a talking chimp. The magician and the chimp soon become the stars of the carnival, drawing in big crowds. However, the wild-animal trainer decides to kidnap Alex and sell him.

Title: 445. Topsy Turvy
description: 1939 pre-WWII Denmark: 17 y.o. Thomas and his conservative parents move in next to a liberal/eccentric family. He vacations with them near the beach and gets to know the same age twins' liberal/erotic ways.

Title: 446. Burning Love
description: A young painter takes up French lessons with an elder lady to ensure he'll get a grant for a French arts institute. That way he meets Anna, a beautiful married woman nursing the lady's old father, and falls in love with her.

Title: 447. The Last Fight
description: Singer-turned-boxer Andy 'Kid' Clave (Ruben Blades) signs a contract with a shady promoter Joaquin Vargas (Willie Colon). But Clave turns against Vargas when the promoter's thugs kill Clave's girlfriend when he thinks about backing out of the contract. While seeking a way to get revenge against Vargas, Clave learns that he has a blood clot in his head. But nothing will deter him from getting his revenge and making a shot at the title.

Title: 448. My Therapist
description: A beautiful sex therapist helps couples make their sex lives more fulfilling.

Title: 449. Debauchery
description: A jaded housewife joins a secret member's-only club in an attempt to salvage her boring marriage.

Title: 450. Lost
description: A little girl gets lost in the wilds of Utah.

Title: 451. The Vals
description: Sam, Trish, Beth, and Annie are four Valley Girls bored with shopping and frat parties. They come across kind Mr. Stanton, who is running a home for orphaned boys. Mr. Stanton and his charges are in danger of being evicted from their home if they don't come up with the rent money that is due, and one of the boys has taken to selling drugs for a couple of sleazy dealers. When Trish's prized "TUBUL R" Mercedes convertible is lost in a bet in which their Beverly Hills rivals have cheated, mayhem ensues as the Vals, with help from their frat-boy boyfriends, save Mr. Stanton and his boys from being evicted, give the drug-dealers their just deserts, and totally exact revenge on the Beverly Hills brats in a rematch.

Title: 452. Enormous Changes at the Last Minute
description: This film is made up of three segments that share no plot but have a general thematic relationship. In the first segment, Virginia and her three children are left by her shiftless husband and she is courted by an old beau who is now married. In the second, a divorced woman reacts to some unexpected revelations from her aged father. In the third, childless, middle-aged social worker is swept into an affair with cab driver Dennis, and finds herself pregnant.

Title: 453. New Wave
description: In 1983, the year women's soccer was regulated in Brazil, a group of girls form a team. As they prepare for an international match, they face the prejudices of a conservative society and deal with their personal problems.

Title: 454. Just a Game
description: A family on vacation must deal with its long-held dark secret when the traumatized eldest daughter tries to break the silence and make her father stop sexually abusing her. Unfortunately, that may prove to be next to impossible.

Title: 455. Open Future
description: A 16 year old boy growing up in the '60s, trying to go his own ways. He is inseparable from his friends and starts dropping school and starts experimenting with life, sex, drugs, alcohol.

Title: 456. How I Was Systematically Destroyed by an Idiot
description: After the death of Che Guevara, self-styled Marxist intellectual Babi Papuska roams Belgrade preaching revolution, but society's indifference turn his ambitions into a tragicomic satire of ideology versus reality.

Title: 457. The Lady Assassin
description: The Qing emperor Kangxi secretly decrees his 14th prince as heir to the throne, but the 4th prince schemes to change the decree to his favor, and is willing to say and do anything to achieve his goal, which leads to dire consequences.

Title: 458. Violentadores de Meninas Virgens
description: A former pimp's crew kidnaps young women in São Paulo, selling them to wealthy men before murdering the victims. With sixteen abductions and ten bodies discovered, police struggle to find any leads on the killers.

Title: 459. You Disturb Me
description: Short stories are connected by two things: love and disturbing. People fall in love after huge fights, and someone is always on their road.

Title: 460. Play Dead
description: A rich, elderly woman casts black magic spells on her vicious Rottweiler to murder her relatives.

Title: 461. Tokatçi
description: A tragicomedy dramatizing how an innocent villager is driven into the crime world only to collect enough cash to make his biggest dream come true: Return to his village home and marry the girl next door.

Title: 462. Private Manoeuvres
description: A spin-off film that centers around Yudale/Huey's mandatory Israeli army service, post boot camp. This time he helps his sergeant Shemesh beat a rival base, while also beating him to score with the visiting Swiss Ambassador's wife.

Title: 463. The Act
description: Blackmail, a complex heist, and political snakery collide into a complicated caper full of disguises and surprises, where it's never clear who's really working for whom.

Title: 464. Pukar
description: Although India obtained freedom from the British in 1947, Goa and its territories are still ruled by the Portuguese. A group of revolutionaries want a free Goa and are thus wanted by the Portuguese administration. Among them are Purandare, Narvekar, and Dinanath, and when Dinanath's whereabouts are known to the police, he escapes with his young son Ramdas and goes to their hideout. With Purandare's assistance they manage to escape, but they're shot. A horrified Ramdas watches Purandare shoot his father dead, and this is how he starts hating revolutionaries. Ramdas changes his name to Ronnie, befriends a girl named Julie, and grows up taking up crime as his career. He soon prospers and lets the villagers also prosper with him. Then when the Police Commissioner is shot dead, Ronnie helps the authorities apprehend his killer, a young man named Shekhar. He is arrested, tried in Court, and sentenced to be hanged. At this point Ronnie finds out that the people he assisted in the past are all against him and sympathize with the revolutionaries. Furious, he grabs a gun to kill Shekar's parents--and finds out who they really are and why Purandare shot his dad.

Title: 465. Palabra de Honor
description: A man of power and principle finds his life falling apart when love and honor collide, forcing him to face the price of his own word.

Title: 466. Vacanze di Natale
description: Christmas holidays on the snow of Cortina D'Ampezzo. Mario, a guy from Rome who has little money, falls in love with American Samantha, the girlfriend of hypochondriac Roberto. Billo, a singer and playboy, encounters Ivana, who is now married to wealthy Donatone but had a fling with Billo in the past, and he wants another chance at lighting the flame.

Title: 467. The Gold Diggers
description: An avant-garde exploration of a woman's life.

Title: 468. El vecindario II
description: The driver of a wealthy family is a rapist at night, but his victims do not accuse him.

Title: 469. Banzaï
description: Michel Bernardin works at Planet Assistance, who helps Frenchmen who are in trouble in foreign countries.

Title: 470. Roy del espacio
description: Alome, emperor of a distant red planet, threatens to destroy Earth. Roy, Dr. Faz and psychologist Elena are sent by Earth leaders in a peace mission, but they get involved in a series of adventures that include romance, robot fights and space battles.

Title: 471. Sacred Ground
description: In 1861 Oregon, a mountain man and his Native American wife live in a cabin built on a Paiute burial site, leading to a violent dispute with the local tribe.

Title: 473. My Breakfast with Blassie
description: Comedian Andy Kaufman & professional wrestler Classy Freddie Blassie eat breakfast & discuss life.

Title: 474. Emerald Cities
description: Emerald Cities, completing the trilogy, is a story about a young woman who runs off from her Death Valley home to seek her fortune. Her drunken dad still stuck in his Santa suit from the local Christmas pagent, follows and soon comes in contact with the "new dark ages" of 1984. Juxtapositions of "on-the street" interviews (by Willie Boy Walker), punk performances by bands Flipper and The Mutants, TV shows of past-life hypnotism and nuclear destruction, and a crazed ex-con all finally intermix with the characters' own sagas.

Title: 475. Second Thoughts
description: Lawyer Amy is being courted by two very different men: her client, roguish street musician Will; and her old boyfriend John Michael. A curious triangle develops as Amy gets pregnant by Will and both men vie for her affections.

Title: 477. Woh 7 Din
description: Maya, coming from poor family, is married to the affluent Dr. Anand; but she tries to commit suicide on the nuptial night. She tells Anand that she was in love with Prem whose ambition was to be a music director. He too was in love with her but thought she would not be happy as his wife. Anand tells Maya that he had married her only for his mother who was on her death bed. When the mother dies Anand wants to unite Prem and Maya but Prem says it is against Hindu culture and disappears from their life.

Title: 478. Ek Jaan Hain Hum
description: While trying to win over his beloved's parents, a young man is accused of arson, and his father soon realizes insanity may be his only defense.

Title: 479. Occhio, malocchio, prezzemolo e finocchio
description: The film is divided into two episodes, The Hair of Disgrace and The Magician, both focusing on the theme of the occult and beliefs.

Title: 480. Fireback
description: A weapons expert is sent to Vietnam to demonstrate a new weapon he has just invented, but he is captured during a Viet Cong attack and imprisoned in a POW camp. He is rescued not long afterwards, but when he returns home he finds that his wife has been kidnapped and he is being set up for a string of crimes that he did not commit. He determines to find out what's going on and who is behind it.

Title: 481. Naughty Boys
description: Sing is an ex-con who's supposed to dig up the buried loot of his three still-jailed buddies, but when he gets to it, he finds that the treasure chest is full of rocks. The other three are convinced that Sing stole the goods for himself.

Title: 482. Female Prisoner: Caged!
description: An inmate attempts to escape from prison and is confronted by the guard.

Title: 483. Le cercle des passions
description: An aristocratic Sicilian family living in the 1950s. Count Villafratti has sex one night with his nymphomaniac daughter because he thinks she is his wife.

Title: 484. The Street Player
description: The life of a football player named Fares who goes through a lot of problems due to his lack of self-discipline with his divorced wife, job, sexual desires and football.

Title: 485. Dressed in Blue
description: Several transvestite prostitutes that work the Madrid streets discuss their personal experiences. The camera follows their daily lives. The lid is also lifted on their personal histories.

Title: 486. Als je begrijpt wat ik bedoel
description: Bumble the Bear (Olivier Bommel) finds an egg that, it turns out, has a cute little dragon in it. However, this dinosaur grows huge every time it is upset. As this causes a lot of problems, Ollie Bommel has to face a difficult dilemma.

Title: 487. Funny Dirty Little War
description: A small revolution breaks out in a small Argentine town, as one group of Peronists calls they newly elected peronist a communist. The newly elected official enlists the aid of allies ranging from the town drunk to young peronists to help hold his post. What follows is a slapstick war with a serious message.

Title: 488. Bade Dil Wala
description: Amrit's generosity and kindness initially lands him in the bad books of a dancer; then in prison; and then as false son-in-law of a very wealthy man.

Title: 489. Bullshot Crummond
description: The dashing Captain Hugh "Bullshot" Crummond (Alan Shearman) - World War I ace fighter pilot, Olympic athlete, racing driver, part-time sleuth, and all round spiffing chap - must save the world from the dastardly Count Otto van Bruno (Ronald E. House), his wartime adversary. And, of course, win the heart of a jolly nice young lady.

Title: 490. Privates on Parade
description: The members of S.A.D.U.S.E.A. (Song and Dance Unit South East Asia) fall in and out of love while trying to dodge Malayan Communist bullets in the late 1940s. Not only that, they have to contend with Bible bashing Major Giles Flack (John Cleese), who creates far more danger than any of the jungle inhabitants. Only gay Acting Captain Terri Dennis (Denis Quilley) seems to be capable of coping with him, but even he isn't aware of the cowardly Sergeant Major Reg Drummond (Michael Elphick) selling arms to the natives.

Title: 491. Katha
description: Secretly in love with his neighbor, a mild-mannered clerk is heartbroken when his much bolder, more charming friend wins her heart instead.

Title: 492. G.B.H.
description: A bouncer is called in to help fight off a mob boss who is trying to take over local night clubs.

Title: 493. Hambone and Hillie
description: A dog (Hambone) treks from New York City to Los Angeles to be reunited with his owner (Hillie), meeting a host of helpers along the way.

Title: 494. Dogs of Hell
description: A pack of Rottweilers, bred and trained by the U.S. military to kill humans, escape to ravage the peaceful mountain resort town of Lake Lure. It is up to the local sheriff to protect his small community.

Title: 495. Faunovo velmi pozdní odpoledne
description: This film was made as a kind of a "protest-song" against the panic fear of getting old and also against flirtation. The main character (played by Leoš Suchařípa) is an elderly man, admittedly competent, but not very responsible. In the continuous fear, he is trying to do as much as he can but, instead of confidence, he only finds out that in the real life one cannot just take but must give as well. Last but not least, one must be able to resign to his age.

Title: 496. Holy Flame of the Martial World
description: Two evil kung fu masters seeking a powerful weapon kill the man who knows its location, but his two infants are separated, one is raised by a righteous kung fu master to avenge his father, and the other is raised by his father's enemy.

Title: 497. Wartime Romance
description: This melodrama revolves around the post-war meeting reunion an intelligent front-line officer, now happily married, and a woman street vendor. This encounter reawakens in them submerged feelings of gratitude and tenderness as the officer recalls how they met during the war and what she used to mean to him. Now he learns that she is alone with a small daughter, the girl's father having been killed at the front. Naturally, he seeks to help them but his wife is not so understanding...

Title: 498. Amok
description: A rural teacher discovers the harsh realities of his South Africa.

Title: 499. Crusher Joe: The Movie
