description: Amid a supposedly simple escort mission, Joe and his crew experience a failure during their warp travel. They wake up just to find out that the passengers are missing. To make things worse, the United Space Force accuses them of committing space piracy and Crusher HQ suspends their licenses for six months. To clear their names, they head out to the dangerous planet of Lagol to find the person who hired them for that particular mission.

Title: 500. Putt Jattan De
description: Two young men find their inherited rivalry exacerbated by a woman with whom they form a love triangle.

Title: 501. O' surdato 'nnammurato
description: Franco leaves for military service in Telese, and promises his girlfriend Maria that the distance will not extinguish his love for her.

Title: 502. Erotic Images
description: Beautiful Britt Ekland gets an education in Hollywood hustling, behind the scenes and behind closed doors,in this sizzling story of celebrity, seduction and sensual temptation. Take a bold look at the sudden fame, sexual games, and the glittery lures of Hollywood with EROTIC IMAGES.

Title: 503. Tin Man
description: A young man, born deaf, invents a computer so he can hear and speak with others.

Title: 504. Children of Darkness
description: Many American youth face mental health challenges and receive treatment in facilities. Poor conditions and inadequate care in public and private institutions often cause more harm than healing.

Title: 505. Kalaakaar
description: Poor and orphan Ravi Kumar is gifted with good singing attributes. He meets wealthy Radha Khanna and with her recommendation he lands his first singing assignment and this takes him to the way of stardom. Soon Radha starts to witness changes in Ravi's behavior towards her; which makes them split up. Unknown to Radha that Ravi has been diagnosed with cancer and does not have long to live.

Title: 506. Revenge in the House of Usher
description: A young doctor visits the secluded home of his ailing mentor - Eric Usher - who believes the house itself is alive and plotting to drive him insane, manifesting itself through ghostly apparitions.

Title: 507. Woman with Pierced Nipples
description: The story of men and women, which starts with harmless, albeit eccentric games. She knows almost nothing about him, but as more and more she learns, the more shocking and at the same time attractive Bole becomes with his secret life. In particular, "a collection of wines", stored in a special vault.

Title: 508. New Life
description: Two friends working at a restaurant get fired from their jobs and after seeing an advertisement for the fishing industry of the Westman Islands, decide to go there and make some money.

Title: 509. Hajji Washington
description: A loyal and simple-minded statesman is appointed as the first Iranian ambassador in the U.S. but soon starts to lose his mind from homesickness and inaction.

Title: 510. Off the Wall
description: Two young hitchhikers are picked up by a speed-crazed, young woman, who tears around the countryside. She leaves them to take the blame for her activities, and they find themselves sentenced to six months in prison. The girl, feeling bad about what she did to them, resolves to break them out.

Title: 511. El poder de la censura
description: The problems affecting a film producer linked to censorship and self-censorship.

Title: 512. I Enjoy the World with You
description: Three middle-aged men go for a vacation with their children and learn to cope with their needs without their wives. Quickly, they plan to exhaust the kids to have some time off, but nothing really works out as planned.

Title: 513. My Best Friend's Girl
description: Isabelle Huppert plays an attractive Parisienne out looking for some fun during her vacation on the ski slopes of Courchevel in the Alps when she starts up a relationship with a great-looking sportswear salesman, but at the same time she is entranced by a little chubby disk jockey in a night club.

Title: 514. Runners
description: When his young daughter disappears, her father refuses to accept that she is dead and sets out on a journey to find her.

Title: 515. Last Plane Out
description: An American journalist covering the civil war in Nicaragua falls in love with a beautiful Sandinista rebel.

Title: 516. The Story of the Voyages
description: In a medieval fantasy kingdom, two orphans, May and his sister Martha, live in poverty. A group of robbers kidnap May to use his magic talent: he feels sick when surrounded by gold, therefore he can feel gold from a long distance.

Title: 517. El hombre del pito mágico
description: Raúl has invented something that can change the destiny of humanity: a whistle whose sound awakens an unstoppable sexual desire.

Title: 518. Una gita scolastica
description: Italy, 1914. Two teachers (Delle Piane and Pini) take their pupils for a school outing from Bologna to Florence.

Title: 519. To Love Again
description: Forced by her father to marry a man she does not love in order to save him from financial ruin, Raffy runs away. Left with no choice but to fend for herself, she takes a secretarial job in a mining company. There she meets Bullet, an adventurous young man who, like her, has left home in order to save himself from a loveless arranged marriage. Together, Raffy and Bullet go through life, coping with its ups and downs, learning about forgiveness, and discovering love in the process.

Title: 520. Dos de abajo
description: Two bricklayers find a hidden treasure in the construction site where they work, and become victims of a great persecution.

Title: 521. Demon of the Lute
description: The lute-demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng-ling is ordered to find a special bow and arrow that can counter the demon.

Title: 522. Arpan
description: Anil loves Shobha, Vinnie loves Rakesh. Both work for JK. After Anil's year abroad, he returns to find Shobha married to JK and Vinnie wed to Rakesh. He marries Sona but still loves Shobha.

Title: 523. Hunter's Crossing
description: "Hunter's crossing" is about a mercenary (Bruce Baron as Al Hunter) trying to rescue a millionnaire's son raptured by Filipino pirates.

Title: 524. Big Shar
description: After five years in prison, con-artist Szu mentors aspiring grifter Jurek in Lutyn, leading to complications as Szu partners with prostitute Jola, and Jurek seeks fortune.

Title: 525. A Love in Germany
description: A foreigner and his son arrive in a small German village and evoke a story that the villagers do not want to remember.

Title: 526. Doctor Yes: The Hyannis Affair
description: A man falls for his nubile stepdaughter. When his hot wife finds out about this, she is furious. Murder ensues. It's obvious who's the guilty party. Or is it?

Title: 527. Chor Police
description: Inspector Sunil Rana (Shatrughan Sinha) has been assigned the case of triple-homicide of the Sinha family, namely Mr. Sinha (Ashok Kumar); his son Inspector Rohan (Vinod Mehra), and Rohan's wife (Bindiya Goswami). After an investigation, Sunil concludes that the assailant can only be Dr. Singh (Kader Khan), who escapes from India, and re-locates to Dubai, United Arab Emirates, far from the jurisdiction of Bombay Police. Sunil must overcome borders to apprehend Dr. Singh, and thus bring justice to the Sinha family. It is then Sunil comes to know that Dr. Singh is not the only one involved in this homicide, which is far more complicated that he had thought it to be so.

Title: 528. The Nun and the Torturer
description: A principled police chief investigates a female teacher suspected of political crimes. After arresting her, he discovers she's a nun, yet must proceed with harsh interrogation methods while fighting an unexpected attraction.

Title: 529. Raskenstam
description: The story of the charlatan Gustaf Raskenstam life and times during World War II, who for financial gain seduced a large number of women.

Title: 530. Adi Shankaracharya
description: The first Indian movie to be made in Sanskrit. The movie follows the life and times of Adi Shankaracharya - the founder of the non-duality (Advaita) school of Indian philosophy. The Jiv-Atman or Individual Self is a mere reflection or limitation of Singular Atman in a multitude of apparent individual bodies.

Title: 531. Sex Crime
description: Three people whose lives have taken a turn for the worse retreat into a world of erotic dreams made flesh.

Title: 532. Trouble-Maker Hüsnü
description: Hüsnü, who is in love Hüsnüye, seeks help from his friend Cemal to get with Hüsnüye but Cemal keeps scamming Hüsnü to get his money. Cemal hears from the people on the streets that a wealthy man named Malik is overtaxing the people in the neighborhood and kicking them out of their homes. Cemal portrays Hüsnü as a fake gangster to the neighborhood to get rid of Malik.

Title: 533. Time for Loving
description: Summer stories from the beaches of Tuscany.

Title: 534. The Princes
description: Nara, a 30-year-old gypsy, lives with her nine-year-old daughter Zorka and her grandmother in a public housing project in the Paris region.

Title: 535. Vai alla grande
description: Rimini in winter. Giorgio, Walter and Dario's dream is to own a boat. Meanwhile, they overcome boredom by inventing an endless series of jokes. Between the three and the rich boys in the area led by Fernando there is a strong rivalry that will become more acute with the arrival of the beautiful Karin, a young German with an ambiguous past. In the meantime, the official regatta arrives that our three friends, through a series of grotesque situations, win. Meanwhile Karin falls in love with Giorgio. Unexpectedly, the "protectors" of the young woman appear in the town. They want to bring her home and reveal the girl's past to Giorgio. After an understandable disappointment, Giorgio, helped by all the boys including Fernando, chases the criminals and frees his beloved.

Title: 536. Flirt
description: After a 22-year marriage, a couple shows the signs of a crisis. She thinks he has a lover, and actually it seems so, but is the lover for real?

Title: 537. Now and Forever
description: A couple's seemingly "perfect" marriage is shaken when the husband is charged with rape.

Title: 538. Al bar dello sport
description: Lino, a penniless Pugliese emigrant to Turin, is an unwelcome guest in his sister and brother-in-law's house. Engaged with Rossana, who leaves him for a friend. Lino makes 13 the pools but keeps it hidden from everyone.

Title: 539. The Challenge of the Lady Ninja
description: During WWII's Japanese occupation of Shanghai, a woman trains in covert arts. Arriving in Hong Kong, she learns her brother aids the Japanese. She assembles female warriors to stop him.

Title: 540. The Prodigal Planet
description: Final and least well-known installment in the Mark IV series of fundamentalist apocalypse films. About to be executed by the forces of the Antichrist, fundamentalist Christian guerrilla David is rescued by Connie, an Antichrist agent pretending to be a double agent for the Believers' Underground. Connie hopes to trick David into leading her to the dissidents' hidden base. Meanwhile, Armageddon and the Second Coming draw nigh.

Title: 541. Abuse
description: Brutally abused by his parents, teenage Thomas finds comfort in associating with a film director who is making a documentary about physical child abuse. The two fall in love, and the elder is faced with the decision of either running away with Thomas or focusing on his career, thereby possibly letting Thomas be beaten to death.

Title: 542. The Crazy Story of the Three Musketeers
description: The three musketeers must help the Queen of France recover a garter belt lost in a love affair before Cardinal Richelieu discredits the Queen at a party where she will have to wear the famous piece of lingerie.

Title: 543. The Millennial Bee
description: A multigenerational saga (1887-1917) parallels a bee colony, with the queen representing family roots and tradition. The Pichanda family faces love, work, crisis, and war, weaving reality with dreams.

Title: 544. To Kill a Stranger
description: The wife of an American journalist on an assignment in an unnamed South American country run by a military junta is sexually assaulted by a stranger there. However, she manages to fight back, which leads to unexpected consequences.

Title: 545. Himmatwala
description: A poor and wronged woman's son returns from the big city to avenge his father, a honest school teacher.

Title: 546. Touched
description: Two mental patients in an institution fall in love and plan to escape in the search of a normal life.

Title: 547. Frida
description: The most prominent female painter of Latin America, Frida Kahlo, is agonizing in her Coyoacán home. She evokes memories of her childhood, of the streetcar accident that caused her terrible pain and affliction, her friendship with Trotsky and painter Alfaro Siqueiros, her marriage to Diego Rivera, her miscarriage, her political commitment, her love affairs and the anticipated exhibition of her works.

Title: 548. Man of Flowers
description: An eccentric elderly man tries to enjoy the three things in life that he considers real beauty: collecting art, collecting flowers, and watching pretty women undress.

Title: 549. Bekhabar
description: This movie unfolds as a murder mystery, where numerous individuals whose names begin with the letter V come under suspicion for a murder. "Bekhabar" narrates the journey towards uncovering the real murderer.

Title: 550. Esprit D'amour
description: A young woman has a tragic accident, slipping on a skateboard and falling off the roof of a tall building. Koo Chi Ming, an insurance investigator, is sent to determine whether the girl's death is an accident or a suicide and he recognizes the young woman from an earlier chance encounter. His boss wants him to conclude it was a suicide so that the insurance company doesn't have to pay. The young woman's ghost visits Koo to tell him that her death was accidental and they fall in love. When Koo's girlfriend and his parents find out he's in love with a spirit, they hire an exorcist to get rid of her.

Title: 551. Fieras en brama
description: Pedro, who is studying at the seminary to become a priest, returns to his grandfather's ranch after his uncle takes ill. He stays to help out and beautiful Elisa, his uncle"s wife. who is unhappy in her marriage seduces him, but it turns out to be a brief infatuation.He then falls in love with his cousin Maria, who is unaware of his brief fling with his uncle's wife. All the while he contemplates his future in the priesthood, facing enormous pressure from his grandfather, who wants him to continue studying to be a priest. Elisa tells Maria about their brief fling, but Maria forgives him. When Pedro and Maria contemplate marriage, he must search his heart for the correct path for him.

Title: 552. Reckless
description: A daredevil motorcycle rider falls for an older artist.

Title: 554. Die Insel der blutigen Plantage
description: A women's prison on a tropical island is a hellhole where the inmates are raped, tortured and otherwise abused by the evil commandant and brutal guards. However, one of the guards falls in love with a beautiful inmate, and decides to help her and all the other prisoners escape.

Title: 555. Atsay Killer
description: THIS COMIC FILM TACKLES SERIOUS SUBJECTS - MURDER, LUST, HOMOSEXUALITY, EXPLOITATION, OF WOMAN, IN TONGUE-IN-CHEEK FASHION.

Title: 556. Thick as Thieves
description: Nicola Calore faces the visit of his niece Rosina who believes that he has become wealthy. Episode 2: The misadventures of two surveyors during their stay in a holiday village in Kenya.

Title: 557. Rush
description: In a post-nuclear holocaust world, a survivor roams the desert, fighting bandits and the forces of an evil warlord.

Title: 558. Prima Veras saga om Olav den hellige
description: The unholy story about the life of Saint Olav the Holy from birth to the day he dies as the Norwegian King at the battle of Stiklestad in 1030.

Title: 559. Ghungroo
description: While on his deathbed, the Emperor promises that his Senapati, Vikram Singh, will be treated like his son, and he will get married to a woman from a royal family. He also asks Vikram to obey every wish and whim of his wife, Ranimaa, to which Vikram agrees to. A few moments later the emperor passes away. After the formal mourning period is over, Ranimaa announces that she would like Vikram to marry Princess Priya. Vikram agrees to this, and soon Priya and he are married with great pomp and ceremony. After this marriage, Priya learns that Vikram really loves a prostitute named Kesarbai, and has only married her as he had promised to obey every wish and whim of Ranimaa. She also finds out that Kesar and Vikram had a baby girl as a result of this relationship. She complains to Ranimaa, and Ranimaa asks Kesar to take her child and leave this region, which she does. Years later, Ranimaa's second son meets with an attractive young woman named Renu, and both fall in love. Their alliance is frowned upon as Renu is the daughter of a prostitute, and has never known who her biological father is, though her mother lives with a man named Suraj. Little do they know that the past will be re-visited, changing everyone's lives and outlooks forever.

Title: 560. Die Supernasen
description: When Mike is left by his girlfriend, he meets Tommy, who just lost his job. The dynamic duo decides deliberately to work as private investigators. Their first case involves a rich man who wants to know if his wife is cheating.

Title: 561. Die Mädchen aus der Peep Show
description: Contrary to popular beliefs, women working in a peepshow are all happy and self-confident beings who enjoy making men happy. This has at least found an undaunted reporter team.

Title: 562. Ogroff
description: A masked lumberjack stalks anyone who enters his woods. Throughout the film we get a variety of people who come in contact with the killer and they don't live to regret it.

Title: 563. The Last Winter
description: Tells the story of two women seeking leads to their missing husbands after the end of the Yom Kippur War (1973). A relationship builds between them when each identified her husband in the same blurred image of a foreign newsreel.

Title: 564. Kletka dlya kanareek
description: Two difficult teenagers Olesya and Viktor are trying to overcome circumstances and break free.

Title: 565. Doktor Civanim
description: Kemal who is a servant in a hospital in Istanbul returns to his village. He presents himself as a doctor and starts to treat people free.

Title: 566. Scusate il ritardo
description: Vincenzo, a 30-year-old apathetic, lazy man who still lives with his mother, has no job and no desire to improve. He meets Anna and falls in love with her, but to keep the relationship alive he must learn to accept more responsibility.

Title: 567. Vahsi Kan
description: Unofficial Turkish remake of First Blood (1982)

Title: 568. Thieves After Dark
description: A couple goes on the run after being accused for a crime they didn't commit.

Title: 569. Shaolin vs. Lama
description: Skilled fighter Sung Li Ting is looking for a Kung Fu master who can beat him in battle and teach him new techniques. Shaolin monk Shao Si Yer introduces Sung Li to the Shaolin teachings, but Sung Li is not allowed to enter the school until the return of a Lama monk who stole a secret scroll containing every known fighting style from the monastery 12 years earlier.

Title: 570. Medeni mjesec
description: The first soft core porn film in former Yugoslavia gained cult reputation for its unique cultural insights, despite its shortcomings, including a lack of coherent plot and basic filmmaking elements.

Title: 571. Maldita miseria
description: Poor people struggle with hardship.

Title: 572. Portrait in Crystal
description: Several violent killings take place in the martial arts world, all involving a mysterious crystal-clad culprit, prompting a sculpture, who's also a master swordsman, and his assistant to search for the real identity of the killer.

Title: 573. The Lost Tribe
description: An anthropologist vanishes in New Zealand during a tribal search. His wife, daughter, and shady twin brother enamored with his sister-in-law embark on a quest to find him, while police suspect one twin in a prostitute's murder.

Title: 574. The Devil and Holy Water
description: After injuries force an AS Roma center forward off the field, he survives on petty scams.

Title: 575. Notturno
description: Musante plays a man blackmailed and forced to assassinate a highly guarded KGB official. Two British agents have kidnapped his daughter and want him to do what they tell him. Why him? He has the ability to see in darkness and is a sharpshooter. Will he get the job done, get his daughter back, and escape from the Russian and British agents that pursue him?

Title: 577. Moon Rainbow
description: After a strange incident, a group of Russian space commandos start developing supernatural powers. But how did they acquire such abilities and what are their intentions?

Title: 578. Survival Zone
description: In a post-nuclear holocaust world, roving bands of motorcycle gangs attack ranchers to try to take over their land.

Title: 579. The Passing
description: Two elderly World War II buddies are living - and dying - together in their small home. One becomes a patient where salvage-worthy, older attributes are combined with useable, younger body parts. He returns, unrecognized by the other.

Title: 580. Clash of Loyalties
description: This movie is about the 1920 revolution in Iraq against the English occupation.

Title: 581. The American Snitch
description: Satire spoof about a "National Enquirer"-type tabloid, featuring a cast of celebrity look-alikes.

Title: 582. Island of Swans
description: Fourteen-year-old Stefan Kolbe, along with his mother and sister, moves from an idyllic small town to the developing area of Berlin-Marzahn, where his father works as a construction worker. Stefan must find his way in a completely new environment and surrounded by strange people. Stefan gets to know two girls, who attempt to seduce him, and gets himself into trouble with the landlord, who kisses up to societal authority figures. He becomes friends with the anxious Hubert, defends him against the constant humiliation of the older student Windjacke, and encourages him to stand up for himself. It ends tragically in a bitter fight between Stefan and Windjacke.

Title: 583. Remedy
description: Problematic life of a newly graduated midwife in a remote village, where winters are really harsh.

Title: 584. Secerna vodica
description: Unsatisfied with her look and lack of sexual experience, a girl whose nickname is Tomboy decide to subject herself under nose surgery. Her best friend begins to observe her from different angle.

Title: 585. Manji
description: A married kleptomaniac (Sonoko) and a younger woman (Mitsuko) begin an unusual love affair which develops fast into a kinky sexual love triangle when Sonoko's husband gets involved.

Title: 586. El crack dos
description: Private detective Germán Areta is investigating the life of a man who has apparently abandoned another man. When they both turn up dead, it seems one killed the other before committing suicide, but Areta is not convinced. After his assistant is murdered, Areta has to chose between his desire to continue the investigation and his fear of dying for nothing.

Title: 588. Ryuji
description: Ryuji tries to quit yakuza and spend a decent life with his wife Mariko and daughter Aya, but as he's used to getting easy money, it'd become hard for him to work hard and get little. Eventually he's back to where he belongs.

Title: 590. Kanakerbraut
description: Story of a 40 year old man, Paul, whose wife has left him, and who works part-time at odd jobs and spends the rest of his time in dingy bars and visiting peep-shows.

Title: 591. Blue Skies Again
description: A hard-hitting, fast, sure-handed baseball player tries to break into the sport by applying for a spot on a major-league-league team. The only problem is that the player is female, which engenders resistance and resentment among many players and officials.

Title: 592. Rescue Team
description: An over-the-top action-packed Filipino jungle action flick about a super tough CIA agent. Bloody violence, a jungle full of bamboo death traps and some double crossing keeps things more than interesting.

Title: 593. Move Along, There is Nothing to See
description: Leroux and Pélissier, are investigating stolen checks. They arrive at Hélène owner of a contemporary art gallery. Pélissier is convinced that she is a stranger to history, but Leroux clings on, convinced that she is hiding something.

Title: 594. Salt & Gold
description: When King Pravoslav's favorite daughter tells him that she loves him more than salt, he's furious since he considers salt to be worthless. Her fiance the Salt Prince makes all the salt disappear to teach Pravoslav a lesson.

Title: 595. Çarikli Milyoner
description: Unofficial Turkish remake of Mr. Deeds Goes to Town (1936)

Title: 596. The Champions
description: Ah Biao stars as an acrobatic country hick who must flee out of town after injuring a wealthy socialite during an innocent competition. While exploring the area, he runs into a soccer team who discovers his talents.

Title: 597. Buddies
description: Young miners Mike and Johnny (Colin Friels and Harold Hopkins) work in the gem fields of central Queensland around Emerald. Conflict arises when their pick-and-shovel operation is threatened by a large scale bulldozer operator.

Title: 598. Flotte Biester auf der Schulbank
description: An young female teacher inherits a condom factory from her uncle.

Title: 599. Sheer Madness
description: Olga and Ruth become friends. Olga is independent, separated from her husband, living with an immigrant pianist, and teaching feminist literature. Ruth is withdrawn, a painter, possibly mentally ill. Ruth dreams in black and white, sometimes of her suicide. Olga lectures on a 19th-century writer, von Günderrode, a suicide after the breakup of her intense friendship with Bettina Brentano. Ruth's husband Franz encourages the women's friendship, then, as Olga draws Ruth out and the friendship deepens, he becomes jealous. After the women travel to Egypt, Franz has a tirade. Ruth seems crushed between her husband and her friend, and how she responds is the film's climax.

Title: 600. Biddy
description: Beginning in 1864 England, and moving through a number of years, a maid helps raise two children, a boy and a girl, all the time talking about her methods in doing so.

Title: 601. At Last... Bullamakanka: The Motion Picture
description: A small town mayor rigs an election with hilarious and unpredictable results. A comedy extravaganza starring some of the biggest names in Australian showbiz in the most unlikely and wackiest roles.

Title: 602. U2: Under a Blood Red Sky
description: U2 perform a live concert at Red Rocks.

Title: 603. Flicks
description: A parody of Saturday afternoon matinees, including coming attractions and a cartoon.

Title: 604. The Ruffian
description: Aldo, in his fifties, works in a gold mine in Northern Canada, in the middle of a bunch of adventurers.

Title: 605. The Illusionist
description: A teenage boy (the Illusionist), dreams of becoming a magician. After his mentally challenged brother is taken to a mental institution due to an attempted strangling, the Illusionist starts a journey to rescue him from being lobotomized.

Title: 606. Life Is a Bed of Roses
description: Three intertwined tales. On the eve of the First World War, Count Forbek starts to build a fantastic castle in the Ardennes forest. After the war he uses it to start a utopian society by brainwashing his friends, including his former fiancee, Livia, and her husband. In the present day, the castle is being used as an alternative school and, in the summer holidays, for an educational conference. At the conference, the American Nora Winkle bets Claudine that the ernest public school teacher Elisabeth Rousseau will be enticed into the bed of Robert Dufresne, even though the principal speaker, Walter Guarini, is obviously interested in Elisabeth. Meanwhile, the children staying at the castle over the holidays invent their own medieval tale about freeing prisoners from the dungeons.

Title: 607. Kabamaru the Ninja
description: A young ninja-in-training moves in with his late grandfather's companion, a school director, and uses his mystical martial arts skills to defend her academy from rival institutions while navigating friendship, rivalry, and romance.

Title: 608. The Roaring Fifties
description: The Second World War is over and now begins in post-war Germany, the reconstruction. Jakob Formann sees his chance here and begins a rapid rise as an entrepreneur.

Title: 609. Doctor Dracula
description: An evil hypnotist puts a beautiful woman under his spell.

Title: 610. Kissise Na Kehna
description: Kailash searches for the perfect bride for his son Ramesh a traditional girl from an Indian village who embodies the values he holds dear.

Title: 611. Pallavi Anu Pallavi
description: A man who is away from his girlfriend developed a crush towards a single mother whose husband had left her.

Title: 613. El hotel de los ligues
description: Three couples are having sexual problems until a porn star shows up and teaches them a few lessons.

Title: 614. Aborto: Canto a la vida
description: Two stories of rape, violence and drama about abortion.

Title: 615. The Swing
description: The life of three sisters in Munich before the First World War. Based on the book by Annette Kolb.

Title: 616. Prisoners
description: A man resettles his American family to New Zealand where he gets a new job at a prison in the city Wellington. His daughter has an affair with one of his prisoners he is to look out for.

Title: 617. Sing Sing
description: Eduardo accidentally discovers that he is adopted. His real father is dying. On his death bed the father reveals that Eduardo's mother was the "Queen of England", failing to clarify that this is the nickname of Italian prostitute.

Title: 618. Innocence
description: In the 19th century, a country girl is seduced by a young doctor who's staying at her house for a few days, caring for her, and tries to hide the forbidden romance from her father, who disapproves of the relationship.

Title: 619. Bank Under Siege
description: A group of criminals is trying to seize almost eight hundred million pesetas at the headquarters of the Central Bank of Barcelona.

Title: 621. Conrad: The Factory-Made Boy
description: In a tin box, 7-year-old instant kid Konrad is brought into the house of the painter Bartolotti, due to a computer error. Not only that she didn't want a child, such a good and polite one as Konrad wouldn't even have come to her in a dream.

Title: 622. Mawaali
description: Ramesh gets employ as an engineer in a factory own and maintain by the wealthy, Goyal Verma. Goyal has a daughter, Nisha who is of marriage-able age and who also is in love with Ramesh. But their marriage is unacceptable by Goyal and in retaliation he fires Ramesh from his job. This does not end here as the next day Goyal is found dead in his bedroom and Ramesh is accuse of killing him; who is also convicted in a court of law and remanded to prison. While in prison he gets to meet his look-alike Gangu - with Gangu entering into the frame-work this opens up a game between Ramesh and the real killers of Mr. Goyal.

Title: 624. Çöl
description: Unofficial Turkish remake of Jaws (1975)

Title: 625. City of Lost Souls
description: A film about the teeming flip side of life in Berlin centered on eccentric characters of almost every imaginable sexual orientation, or disorientation.

Title: 626. Le grand carnaval
description: The story follows Americans in Algeria at the time of the Allied invasion of North Africa in 1942.

Title: 627. Mani di fata
description: Andrea, a 40-year-old engineer, suddenly becomes unemployed at the exact same time that his wife Franca gets a promotion. He is very despondent and does not want to be a burden to his family, so he takes the place of their housemaid, then goes to work for a countess and meets someone who could help him in his chosen career.

Title: 628. Karate
description: A scientist creates a diamond that can focus sun-rays to burn through anything. The villain, in a bid to get the diamond, kills the scientist. The scientist's karate-learning sons, Desh and Vijay, are separated from each other and their mother. Vjay grows up with his karate instructor while Desh is reared by a gypsy camp. How they find each other and avenge their father's death forms the rest of the narrative.

Title: 629. El mil usos
description: The tragic adventures of a illiterate man named "Milusos" who leaves his family & hometown to go to the big city and try to better his luck. And finds he's unprepared for what he encounters.

Title: 630. He Makes Me Feel Like Dancin'
description: Jacques d'Amboise, a noted former American ballet star who had dancing roles in such films as Seven Brides for Seven Brothers (1954) and Carousel (1956), and who later became a New York dancing instructor.

Title: 631. Khaidi
description: When a poor farmer's son, Suryam, falls in love with a vicious feudal lord's daughter, the man ensures that Suryam's life is made miserable.

Title: 632. Pharos of Chaos
description: Documentary profile of actor Sterling Hayden .

Title: 633. Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
description: A second-rate private eye sees a woman's UFO abduction claim as his ticket to fame and fortune.

Title: 634. El marqués, la menor y el travesti
description: Gold-digging Alicia goes to great lengths to get a smooth and handsome Count.

Title: 635. Laboratory
description: Aliens kidnap a group of humans in order to perform experiments upon them.

Title: 636. Ghost Dance
description: Through the experiences of two women in Paris and London, Ghost Dance offers a stunning analysis of the complexity of our conceptions of ghosts memory and the past.

Title: 637. Hadley's Rebellion
description: A small town lad's passion for authentic wrestling is not matched by those around him at a California prep school.

Title: 638. SS Operation Wolf Cub
description: A mercenary soldier on a dangerous mission is trying to infiltrate Neo Nazis in Sweden.

Title: 639. Moving Out
description: Gino, an Italian teenager in an Australian suburb, struggles to fit in, but perseveres until finally forming bonds with his Aussie peers before unexpectedly moving away.

Title: 640. The Bund: Part II
description: After losing everything, a young man rebuilds his life and finds love in 1920s Shanghai -- all while rising to power in an organized crime syndicate.

Title: 641. Framed Youth: The Revenge of the Teenage Perverts
description: Gay and lesbian teenagers interview straight people on the streets of London about their views on homosexuality.

Title: 642. Un hombre llamado el diablo
description: Stepping into a small town with the intent of getting revenge, a mysterious man interrupts the lives of the local men and women by summoning their deepest fears and desires.

Title: 643. Munthanai Mudichu
description: A woman finds a husband and tries to win his love through unconventional means.

Title: 644. An Uneventful Story
description: Another monotonous day in the dull life of a medical professor, disillusioned by his university work, students, wife and family.

Title: 645. Aesop's Fables
description: Aesop's Fables or Manga Aesop's Fables (also known as Manga Isoppu Monogatari in Japanese) is a 1983, Japanese, anime film.

Title: 646. A Stone in the Mouth
description: A fugitive takes refuge in a manor where a blind retired thespian lives.

Title: 648. La discoteca
description: A young man tries to resist the advances of a hotel owner's daughter while his girlfriend waits for him back home.

Title: 649. Joe's Bed-Stuy Barbershop: We Cut Heads
description: The illegal affairs of a recently deceased barbershop owner get passed down to his manager.

Title: 650. Kalabaliken i Bender
description: The famous Swedish Karoliner army has suffered its biggest defeat ever at Poltava in 1709. The Swedish king Karl XII is waiting in the small village of Bender for the Turkish Sultan to help him defeat his arch enemy, the Czar of Russia, Peter the Great. But the Turks think he's an expensive guest and want him out of Turkey. However, he refuses. The Sultan then decides to send Karl XII a princess to marry him, to get him out of the country (a bride for a bribe). The two Swedish soldiers Lagercrona and Kruus are to escort the princess. They experience many different adventures on their way to Bender, namely because other Swedish soldiers and agents try to stop them from ever reaching the village, because they don't want Karl XII to leave Turkey. After their long adventure to get there and a few misunderstandings, the famous "kalabalik" of Bender, where the Turks decide to drive Karl XII out of Turkey by force, begins.

Title: 651. Taqdeer
description: Widower Pratap Singh lives a wealthy lifestyle along with two married sons, Randhir and Ranvir. While Ranvir's wife continues to be childless, Randhir has a daughter, and his wife is expecting a second child. Pratap wants Randhir to invest the family's gold and jewelry, which are hidden underneath the Mandir of Bhagwan Shri Shivji, in a foreign country, but Randhir refuses, arguments ensue, Randhir moves out, and starts his own business, a coal mine. Shortly thereafter, there is an accident in the mines, over 300 miners are killed. The Police arrest Randhir, he is tried in Court, found guilty, and sentenced to 20 years in prison. After his term ends, he is discharged and will soon find out that his wife and father are dead, his second child is missing believed to be dead, a prostitute has taken over the identity of his daughter, and a hoodlum, Shiva, is waiting to kill him.

Title: 652. Black Magic with Buddha
description: The story is about two explorers who invade a temple in the dark of a jungle. They find a mummy, remove its brain, and return to the mainland - resulting in a series of bloody murders throughout the city.

Title: 653. Regina Roma
description: An aging couple search for peace and family harmony when their only son returns home after a long absence with his fiancee.

Title: 654. Burning Princess
description: Four couples get into swapping.

Title: 655. Coaster: The Adventures of the John F. Leavitt
description: Six years in the making, "COASTER" is the true story of a wooden coastal schooner the John F. Leavitt. It is the story of the sea, seen through the eyes of a Melville...a rich human drama set against the backdrop of the harsh North Atlantic and the rugged coast of Maine. Prepare yourself to set sail on an adventure that will leave you deeply enriched - a story that will move every member of your family.

Title: 657. Misterele Bucurestilor
description: The Principality of Wallachia with the capital Bucharest (today a region of Romania) before the Revolution of the year 1848. A couple of secret societies are working to chase away the Prince Gheorge Bibescu from his throne, arms are transported on secret ways, preparing the first popular revolts in Bucharest, as the first act of the Revolution of 1848, which revolution is the first impulse of the later act of the Union of the Wallachia with Moldavien (Romanian United Principalities in 1862, Kingdom of Romania in 1881 and Kingdom of Greater Romania 1918, with Transylvania, Bukovina and Bessarabia)

Title: 658. Naukar Biwi Ka
description: Jagirdar Bishamber Nath a wealthy man disowns his son, police inspector Amar Nath for marrying against his wishes. In the course of his duties Amar sends a notorious criminal Pinto to jail. In due course, Pinto escapes from prison and begins a vendetta which results in several deaths, children being separated from parents and the loyalty of a family driver which saves Jyoti. As the children grow up there is a peek behind the scenes of movieland in Bombay, abductions, being loved, unrequited love, broken childhood engagement, success in stardom, suicide and failure. Does Amar's daughter Jyoti find her true love? Is wealthy Bishamber Nath destined to a lonely old age?

Title: 659. The Worker
description: Manolo has to work non stop to make sure his daughter can study at a prestigious school in Madrid.

Title: 660. Hangin' Out
description: The girl Tina is sick of her Bavarian hometown. She wants to go with Tino who has to leave the village alone for dubious reasons. Tina follows him with her friend Robby on his scooter.

Title: 661. P & B
description: Pettersson and Bendel are both worn, run-down and broke. Despite this they decide to start a business and become rich. Unexperienced they are open to any deal. They tamper, scam and exploit loopholes that exist.

Title: 662. Female Mercenaries
description: Espionage drama with a band of intrepid female fighters combating terrorists.

Title: 663. The Pool Hustlers
description: Francesco, nicknamed 'Toscano', is a very good pool player but he never wins when he plays for money. He meets Chiara, a saxophone player, on a late night bus by swapping his case containing the cue with her one, containing the sax. The two fall in love, but in the meantime Francesco loses a big amount of money playing versus 'Scuro', the long-time Italian champion. His only chance to pay the debt is to win the Italian Championships.

Title: 664. Ascendancy
description: Connie is a member of the British landowning "Ascendancy" in Ireland after WWI. Through a chance friendship with a British soldier, she learns how sheltered she has been, and chooses to ally herself, in her own way, with the struggle for Irish independence.

Title: 665. Pain
description: A village lass lives up to her reputation as an exhibitionist-nymphomaniac with on qualms.

Title: 666. Walking, Walking
description: The assuming of responsibility by individuals, the use of science for man and not against him, the duty of truth to increase the stature of people, all together: these are the important themes this movie debates in allegorical form. Roles are performed by non professional actors and actresses.

Title: 667. Shout for Joy
description: Rick Irons (Robert Pierce) moves to Hawaii to live in paradise; surf the gigantic waves. At a party, Rick meets Alma (Maureen McCormick) who quickly becomes a love interest. While dating Alma, he begins to train for the United States surfing title. As Rick's life is racing to the top on the outside, he personally feels like the bottom is falling out on the inside.

Title: 668. Detective Story
description: A private detective and a college student find themselves in hot water while investigating the murder of a night club owner.

Title: 669. Descendant of the Sun
description: Yuen becomes immortal after 500 years of practicing at the Dai Lor realm. His arch nemesis demon descends to earth, so he descends after him in the form of an infant. 18 years later, they come to a clash while defending a princess.

Title: 670. Bhakta Prahlada
description: Prahlada is a devotee of Lord Vishnu unlike his father who is an atheist. With admonitions along his way, he must change the way his father thinks.

Title: 671. Unico in the Island of Magic
description: A young unicorn named Unico must fight an evil magician and save everyone who's trapped under his spell.

Title: 672. Growing Up
description: The story follows a young man as he changes from an intelligently aware youth, to a teenager with much less confidence than he once had, and finally, to a stable adult.

Title: 673. The Little Bunch
description: A great child group adventure music movie -no words spoken - le petite bande - small band - scape from their music class... excellent for every age, a film that you can watch happily with your children.

Title: 674. The Hereafter
description: A man inherits his father's fortune but must live in the haunted family home and run the sawmill to keep his inheritance, where unexplained events test his sanity.

Title: 675. Srdecný pozdrav ze zemekoule
description: The Earth is approached by a flying saucer with two visitors from outer space. It turns into a beer keg and lands on the back of a truck. Second landing aliens, this time in a container for rubbish dump, land in the middle of the public settlement. Aliens, called A and B look like a normal people.

Title: 676. Poor Child, Rich Child
description: Two young boys' lives are very different: while one enjoys every comfort, the other has barely enough to eat.

Title: 677. California Cowboys
description: A young American is framed and thrown into a Mexican prison. His friends journey to Mexico to break him out.

Title: 678. 'Blow the Night!' Yoru o buttobase
description: Fifteen-year-old Namie Takada moves to a rural city, comes up against a Yanki gang at her new school, and experiences escalating tensions culminating in a riot.

Title: 679. Black Wax
description: A portrait of the blues poet Gil Scott-Heron, who gives a personal tour of Washington, D.C. and performs a concert with his Midnight Band.

Title: 680. Bacanal de Colegiais
description: A metalinguistics exercise in pornography: a blue movie is depicted on another blue movie.

Title: 681. Grunt!
description: A tribe of primitive men worship an egg, which when struck by lightning has acquired magic powers. A rival tribe succeeds in stealing the egg.

Title: 682. Pink Cut: Love Me Hard, Love Me Deep
description: Mayumi and her friend Mai open a unique barber shop where they serve clients while naked, turning their unconventional business model into a profitable venture.

Title: 683. Uruvangal Maralam
description: A deeply pious man meets God, who tells him about various events that will take place in the future. The man tells everyone about these predictions but nobody believes him.

Title: 684. Do Gulaab
description: Heera comes from a Hindu family where-by several run-ins with a young Christian woman named Ruby leads to a romantic attraction. Ruby's parents, Steven and Stella objects to the lovers relationship thus arranging Ruby's marriage else where and at the same time throwing Heera behind bars. Heera's father, Bholanath comes to his rescue only to confined him to his room so as to prevent him from meeting with Ruby there by splitting up the lovers relationship.

Title: 685. The Ballad of the Valiant Knight Ivanhoe
description: The knight Ivanhoe comes back from a crusade and tries to restore the honor, the rights for the inheritance and to achieve a hand of the beloved. This the historian - the adventure saga about the noble knight who appears the involved in furious fight for the English throne between prince John and his brother king Richard.

Title: 686. Il cavaliere, la morte e il diavolo
description: A family of the three fall into a dark and disturbing nightmare after meeting the mysterious Orlok and the seductive punk girl Patty.

Title: 687. For Members Only
description: Three intertwining tales of status and lust play out in a Venetian "orchid house," a mysterious clinic wherein the members' most intimate sexual desires are revealed and fulfilled.

Title: 689. Sapore di mare 2 - Un anno dopo
description: More summer stories from the beaches of Tuscany.

Title: 690. The Death of Mario Ricci
description: The tragic accident of an Italian laborer ,working on the Mont Blanc tunnel.

Title: 691. Nishaan
description: When a villain tries to break the friendship of two friends, they realise that they are brothers and set out to take revenge against the people responsible for their separation.

Title: 692. Gupchup Gupchup
description: A father fed up with frequent tantrums of his college going daughters in Bombay decides to send them to study in Goa.

Title: 693. Of the Flesh
description: A groom takes his city bride to his hometown to settle in his father's house. Struck by her uncanny resemblance to his dead wife, the patriarch is driven to lust after his daughter-in-law. When things come to a head, a violent family quarrel ensues and leads to tragedy. A middle-aged spinster recounts the tale to reveal her identity and trace the downfall of the landowning clan trapped in the past.

Title: 694. Red Spell Spells Red
description: While filming in Malaysia, a Hong Kong documentary film crew releases the Red Dwarf ghost from her tomb. They continue on to Borneo to stay with a local tribe. It is there that the deadly ghost begins to kill them one by one.

Title: 695. The Killing of Satan
description: To fullfil his dead uncle's task and to save his kidnapped daughter, an ex-convict must go and fight a powerful but villainous magician. This fight would lead him eventually to a battle against Satan himself.

Title: 696. Paulo Roberto Cotechiño centravanti di sfondamento
description: In Italy in the early 1980s, a Brazilian football ace is afflicted by nostalgia for his country and for his beautiful girlfriend.

Title: 697. Papa, Can You Hear Me Sing?
description: A poor army veteran in Taiwan adopts a daughter. She grows up and leaves him to enter show business. When she becomes famous she shuns her father and friends.

Title: 698. Lekhayude Maranam: Oru Flashback
description: The movie narrates the story of a poor Malayalee family reaches Madras to try luck for their daughter Shantamma in the film industry.

Title: 699. Sábado, sabadete...
description: Five friends living in Madrid decide to spend a weekend camping together in the mountains.

Title: 700. Brady's Escape
description: This movie is about the love and protection of a man from another culture from the lowly horsemen of the plains in Hungary during World War II.

Title: 701. En busca del dragón dorado
description: Adapted from Poe's The golden beetle", a little girl rescues another girl, and they become involved in the search of an ancient treasure in a mysterious land, hidden by natives in order not to allow bad hombres to take it.

Title: 702. Nastik
description: A devout Hindu priest's son sees his father murdered and his mother and sister burned alive. He becomes an atheist and vows to avenge his family's murders at the hands of an evil landowner and smuggler.

Title: 703. Kyokon densetsu: Utsukushiki nazo
description: Shinohara, a young bodybuilder, joins a para-military sect in northern Japan. His instructor, Takizawa, takes a liking to the new recruit. After an early "special" training session the two develop a lasting and loving relationship.

Title: 704. Final Yamato
description: A watery world called Aquarius that is destined to destroy all of the planet Earth. Can the great Yamato stop this devastation?

Title: 705. Soldados de plomo
description: Andrés returns to his city after a long time to take care of an old mansion that his father has bequeathed him, at first it seems that he's going to sell it quickly to his stepbrother Ramón who wants to tear it down to build flats, but the desire to investigate in the family's past and above all, find out how his father died, makes the deal more dilated than expected.

Title: 706. Haram
description: A young beautiful textile factory worker is courted by the ambitious driver Faruk. They plan to get married but Faruk's boss Fikret has other plans for him. The wedding is postponed and Faruk lands in jail.

Title: 708. Oridathoru Phayalvaan
description: The story of an impotent wrestler whose wife is driven to an extra-marital affair.

Title: 709. Nipernaadi
description: The story is about an Estonian Don Juan, who actually is a writer, who leaves home in spring and is brought home again in autumn, by his wife.

Title: 710. A Friend of Vincent
description: The friendship between two men is put to the test when one of them is accused by a woman of having killed her sister.

Title: 711. The Wheel of Life
description: Three people with their karma entwined meet in three different periods of Chinese history: Ming Dynasty China, early Republican China, and modern-day Taiwan.

Title: 712. The Returning
description: Two different men are possessed by spirits of Native Americans after they separately wander into a sacred burial ground. When John and Sybil come home with their son after a trip to the Mojave Desert, they bring an unusual stone back as a memento of the trip. The stone seems to cause strange noises and other horrible inexplicable phenomena.

Title: 713. S.P.U.K.
description: A commander of the youth working action brigade wants his team to win the award, but the problem arises when a series of graffiti regarding his subordinates' dissatisfaction begins to appear on the facilities across the camp.

Title: 714. Film Hi Film
description: Pran struggles to make a film with newcomers but nobody is willing to finance his flick.Many big stars of 70/80's have special appearances.

Title: 715. Ladies Night
description: The owner of a male strip club becomes the subject of a planned exposé by an undercover TV reporter that soon finds them both embroiled in a world of intrigue and betrayal.

Title: 716. Hanguin mo ako sa putik
description: A young women hopes to find redemption from a sinful past in the the arms of an elderly but genuinely caring lover.

Title: 717. Aa Rathri
description: Indu leads a happy married life with her husband Ravi. However, their happiness is short lived when a series of unfortunate events happen in their life.

Title: 718. Blue Rain Ôsaka
description: Tale of sorrow and nostalgia mixed with pop songs and feminine strength.

Title: 719. Devta
description: A kidnapper falls in love with his kidnappee...but can the pair make it work?

Title: 720. Benvenuta
description: A passionate affair set against the intense encounter between a film-maker and a novelist. The story begins with young scriptwriter François tracking down the author of a once-scandalous novel. His aim is to adapt the work for the screen but several elements of the novel he finds difficult to comprehend. The author, Jeanne, is initially cautious of relaying information, insisting the presumably autobiographical book in no way relates to her personal life. However, eventually she takes the man into confidence to tell the background of Benvenuta. She paints the picture of a musical virtuoso who against her better judgment becomes involved with an Italian magistrate. It's a no-holds-barred passion of hot temperaments doomed to a miserable conclusion.

Title: 721. Todo un hombre
description: An unusual role for Vicente Fernandez who plays a complicated man, out of touch with his feelings due to a childhood incident which left him "damaged" as well as the people who love him.

Title: 722. Viadukt
description: Based on a true story, this film is a dramatization of the events that led to the destruction of one of the most famous trains in history, the Orient Express.

Title: 723. Kakav deda takav unuk
description: Zika and Milan are fighting over who gets to spend more time with grandson Misha, who is five years old. Although Misha lives with his parents in Milan grandfather, Zika all ways of trying to learn Misa tavern life and his craft. A Milan his grandson sent to violin lessons and English. Come up with a number of interesting situations.

Title: 724. Covek sa cetiri noge
description: On a New Year's Eve, an aged man who filed a lawsuit against himself gets an unexpected visit by his sexy neighbor, a half-naked lady that had to face the power-cut in the middle of her shower.

Title: 725. Mission Thunderbolt
description: Explosive early Hong Kong action film about a mysterious criminal known as the White Tycoon, who hires three top assassins to help him eliminate his rivals in two local mobs, the Scorpions and the Serpents.

Title: 726. The Lady Is the Boss
description: The pre-eminent martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang came up with the novel idea for this exciting and hilarious kung-fu clash between an old-fashioned kung-fu master and a hip and beautiful marketing wiz.

Title: 727. Houligans: Kato ta heria ap' ta niata
description: A young man joins a group of hooligans.

Title: 728. El sexo de los pobres
description: Cloromiro has difficulties to contain his sexual desires and now he need the help of a lawyer to stay out of prison for public misconduct.

Title: 729. Svarta fåglar
description: A meeting between the Swedish/French Simone and the Norwegian Stein at a book convention in Frankfurt turns into something more. They keep contact by phone and cassettes, but it seems they don't dare to take the relationship any further.

Title: 730. The Terence Davies Trilogy
description: Three autobiographical short films made over seven years about a young gay man coming to terms with his Catholic schooling, his homosexuality and guilt, his parents and their deaths, despair and loneliness.

Title: 731. Madam Scandal - Final Scandal: Madam Likes It Hard
description: Midori Satsuki plays Tamako, the owner of a boarding house and a pawn shop who gets into some erotic entanglements.

Title: 732. All the King's Men
description: It's the 10th century BC, the emperor is not well, and the medicines he is receiving from con artist "Immortal Li" are in reality only making him worse.

Title: 733. Deadly Life of a Ninja
description: A man receives a Ninjitsu death threat and needs to enlist in the aid of someone trained in the art of the Ninja to catch the would be assassin.

Title: 735. Wudang
description: China, 1889: Quan Lin as the daughter of a kung fu master. When her father is slain by Japanese fighters in a rigged match, the girl vows revenge and consults a Taoist priest who was once her father's colleague.

Title: 736. The Feathered Coyote
description: An old potter and his granddaughter are invited to an archaeological convention in Acapulco where they are hired to create a copy of a well-known Mexica artifact in order to protect the original.

Title: 738. Rachna
description: Selfish Raj must marry to inherit a fortune. He weds ailing Rachna, expecting her demise. She recuperates, and Raj falls for her but mistreats her after learning his motives. Rachna departs upon discovering Raj's true intentions.

Title: 739. Rang Birangi
description: Sparkling comedy about a meddling friend whose attempt to rekindle the spark in his friend's relationship with his wife of seven years leads to complications to their lives, and to the lives of his secretary and her boyfriend he has not 'scripted' ... Splendid performances by Amol Palekar, Deepti Naval, Parveen Babi and Farooq Shaikh, a perfectly pitched script, witty dialogue and a plethora of aptly placed film references make this a film one can watch over and over and never fail to laugh out loud.

Title: 740. Marvin & Tige
description: Marvin is a heavy-drinking widower who's seen better days and now ekes out a living at odd jobs. He meets Tige, an 11-year-old boy about to kill himself because his mother has just died. With nowhere else to stay, Tige moves in

Title: 741. Pieta
description: The story of a mother's passionate, undying love for her criminal son even in the most trying, compromising, difficult situations.

Title: 742. Profissão Mulher
description: The destiny of four women - a beautiful model, an alcoholic, a middle-aged spinster and a famous model - is traced inside an advertising agency. They all look for true love and professional recognition, but get involved in turbulent relationships instead.

Title: 743. Faleze de nisip
description: The plot confronts an influential surgeon and a carpenter accused to have stolen the doctor's personal belongings from the beach. The neurotic doctor involves himself in the inquiry, ultimately directing the interrogation. The burglary victim, Theodor Hristea, a surgeon at the peak of his career and social life, self-confident and well connected, his girlfriend, Cristina and their common friend, Stefan - find themselves on holiday near the summer resort of Mamaia. The doctor has a detective passion and accuses - just on account of a physical resemblance with the real thief - a young carpenter who happens to come at the same beach the day following the burglary. The police is summoned and The Kid is sent to trial. The doctor plays an active part in the investigation. Although the doctor's girlfriend and his friend doubt the identity of the accused, the surgeon insists in being right and succeeds in sending the innocent young man to prison.

Title: 744. Baba!
description: Theresa (Yasmine Bleeth) is an imaginative, rebellious orphan from Brooklyn, who has dreams of show business success. She tries outrageous schemes to launch herself into the public eye, until finally meeting mentor, Sammy Cohen (Buddy Hackett), whose own career fizzled as a result of alcoholism. Official Selection Toronto and AFI Film Fest.

Title: 745. Dolce e selvaggio
description: A Mondo documentary that juxtaposes footage of death, carnage, and unpleasantness with scenes of inspiring and beautiful imagery.

Title: 746. Hwaya
description: Wong-ho is sent by Tobaran to Hong Kong under the pretense of competing in a martial arts match. However, Tobaran actually needs Wong-ho to defeat 6 fighters who are trying to find the location of a million dollars in gold. Tobaran is killed and the 6 villains come to believe that Wong-ho and his girlfriend, Linda, are in possession of the 7 necklaces which reveal the treasure's location

Title: 747. Ninja vs. Shaolin
description: In Japanese-occupied China, a group of ruthless ninjas schemes to take control of a Shaolin temple - and all of its riches - by any means necessary. The peaceful Shaolin monks are reluctant to engage the ninjas in combat but are eventually forced to defend themselves.

Title: 748. La ingenua, la lesbiana y el travesti
description: Three-way relationships between characters of different attitudes toward life and sex.

Title: 749. Last Night at the Alamo
description: Cowboy, and assorted blue collar buddies, inneffectually try to save a true Texas Honky Tonk from closing for good.

Title: 750. Inside the Love House
description: Joe and Tara decide to spice up their love life by visiting a mysterious carnival funhouse.

Title: 751. O Drakoulas ton Exarheion
description: A mad scientist creates the band Music Brigades from body parts of dead musicians.

Title: 752. Awesome Lotus
description: Emily Ann, an innocent Iowa farm girl turned lethal mistress of the martial arts is recruited to stop a crazed Nazi pianist suspected of murdering fashion models to avenge the death of his beloved basset hound.

Title: 754. Questo e quello
description: Two episodes. The 1st is 'Amore impossibile' (Impossible love). Giulio is a comic book draftsman. He is passing through a creativity depressed period. One day his editor makes him meet a blond nice girl. Immediately Giulio fall in love and starts to draw his impossible love story into a new comic book. The 2nd is 'Quello dal basco rosso' (the one with the red beret). Sandro, a mature man, meets one of his former girlfriend and her daughter Daniela. Daniela couldn't have sex with her boyfriend because of a childhood remembrance. In fact she always remember her mother having sex with a man wearing a red beret. She discovers that man is Sandro, makes love with him and soon recovers from her obsession.

Title: 755. Le démon dans l'île
description: On an island, things start going crazy as the islands house hold appliances go rogue. It's up to Dr. Gabrielle Martin to discover what's causing this evil, and much more.

Title: 756. The Big Score
description: A narcotics detective lets nothing stand in the way of his bringing down a major drug dealer.

Title: 757. Sadismo - Aberrações Sexuais
description: In a big city, perverted sexual crimes are happening.

Title: 758. México 2000
description: Humor approach of a futuristic view and Mexican political satire of what the year 2000 could look like from the 80s viewpoint.

Title: 759. Doll's Eye
description: The stories of three women: a researcher, a prostitute and a part-time switchboard operator.

Title: 760. Liberty belle
description: Julien is a left-leaning student whose politics and love interest end up clashing as the young man makes a long, epic journey through his years at a private school in Paris when Algeria is fighting France for its independence, up to his time spent as a courier for Algeria's National Liberation Front (known by their French acronym, the FLN). While at school, Julien already had a conflict with his good friend Gilles and the right-wing politics that Gilles embraces. This relationship will come to have a crucial bearing on the future, as Julien continues on his path to maturity.

Title: 761. Snezenky a machri
description: Story about a class of sixteen year olds learning how to ski.

Title: 762. Molly
description: When weary Old Dan collapses at Central Railway Station he entrusts his beloved dog Molly to young Maxie. Maxie takes up the challenge, developing a soft spot for her special new companion - a dog with the rare ability to sing in tune.

Title: 763. Strangers in Paradise
description: A girl grew up alone in a secluded island, ostracized by the people for being born out of wed lock. A young Hawaii-based Filipino-speaking tourist came and brought her to Hawaii where she learned unexpected truth about her past.

Title: 764. Mazdoor
description: A laborer-turned-businessman faces challenges after the marriage of his children.

Title: 765. To psonio
description: A star-wannabe actor, usually working as a clumsy extra, gets a life opportunity when a venal theater protagonist gets him under her protection.

Title: 766. Mad Dog II
description: The titular "Mad Dog", actually goes under the very anonymous name "Nick Nolte". He is a cop who doesn't take it easy when the mob executes his stripper-sister, and he goes after them to get revenge at all costs.

Title: 767. Dance of the Dwarfs
description: An anthropologist hires a down-on-his-luck helicopter pilot to fly her into the jungle, where she is searching for a scientist who is investigating reports of a tribe of reptile-men.

Title: 768. Çocuklar Çiçektir: Kuduz
description: It depicts rabies horror emerging in a small town during World War II. Hashim, village headman, brings a dog as a gift which turns out to be rabid, biting village children. Entire village mobilizes for the urgent vaccination of children.

Title: 769. The Last Night
description: Two psychos escape from the maximum security wing of Broadmoor Prison and sneak in the backdoor of a theatre to hide away while a performance of a stage play titled "Murder in the Dark" stages its final night.

Title: 770. Koodevide?
description: Alice, who lives with her brother, is a teacher at a convent school in Ooty. A neglected and unruly son of a MP, Xavier Puthooran joins the school in Alice's class. Alice manages to turn him into a prize student. Her boy friend Capt. Thomas feels intensely jealous of the attention Alice bestows upon Ravi.

Title: 771. Village in the Mist
description: A vagabond called Kaechoi is troubled by all the inhabitants of a remote South Korean village. His secret is unearthed by an innocent lady teacher who has moved to that village from the city.

Title: 772. La rosa de los vientos
description: Exiled Chilean director Patricio Guzmán filmed in Cuba and in Venezuela to create this controversial statement on the creation and survival of Latin American culture from the late-15th century to the present. For some viewers, the film will be superficially symbolic and rhetorical, for others, it will be a strong and personal vision of several centuries of history.

Title: 773. Al-azraa wa al shaar al abyad
description: After a woman loses hope of bearing a child of her own, she adopts an orphan against her husband's will, but when the child becomes a young woman, she falls in love with her adoptive father.

Title: 774. Oliver
description: This is Nick Deocampo's masterpiece, a documentary about a gay nightclub performer with an especially lurid "Spider-man" act. Oliver is a female impersonator who supports his family by performing in Manila's gay bars.

Title: 775. L'africain
description: A travel executive goes to Africa with plans to build a luxury holiday resort. Once arrived, she clashes with her ex-husband, who has moved there to escape civilization.

Title: 776. Buenas, y con... movidas
description: A brothel sex-worker tries to hide her profession from her daughter and her boyfriend.

Title: 777. Kinnaram
description: Two young men in madras love same woman who work with them.

Title: 779. The Baggy Trousers Case
description: A group of women in a small village get organized against the macho men of the town.

Title: 780. Shubh Kaamna
description: Ratan arranges Sujata's marriage with Mr. Mehra due to her father's financial constraints. However, his meddling may backfire, raising questions about the desires of Sujata and Mr. Mehra.

Title: 781. Las viciosas y la menor
description: A young woman, in love with a peasant, tries her fortune as a model in the capital, where she is seduced by lesbians.

Title: 782. The Eighties
description: This is a making of a musical, with Chantal Ackerman behind and in front of the camera. It is mostly a collection of clips, talks, directions, and lectures, with the camera capturing the whole adventure.

Title: 783. Karate po polsku
description: The story takes place in a small, provincial town in Masuria. Beginner artist painter Piotr comes here from Warsaw to paint frescoes in the local church. Piotr is a great karate and treats everyone as potential rivals. His antagonist is Roman, the head of local hooligans. Soon there is a conflict between them and the situation becomes very dramatic.

Title: 784. Silencio asesino
description: A group of criminals kidnaps a millionaire's daughter.

Title: 785. De vlaschaard
description: Authoritarian farmer Vermeulen rules his estate and family with strict control. When his hardworking son Louis takes the initiative to finish the harvest while his father is away, the returning tyrant commits an unforgivable crime.

Title: 786. White Snake Enchantment
description: After saving a woman (Rumiko Koyanagi) from committing suicide at a waterfall, a priest (Tomisaburo Wakayama) and his son (Tetta Sugimoto) both fall in love with her.

Title: 787. Amada
description: In 1914, during World Ward I, Amada, a bourgeois wife, falls in love with her cousin Marcial, a young idealist who is fighting against the Cuban regime in power.

Title: 788. Twenty Years of African Cinema
description: A look at 20 years of African Cinema. The Featured extracts are: 'Les Bicots-Negres'(d. Med Hondo) 'Borom Serret' (d. Sembene Ousmane)1966 'La Noire de...' [Black Girl] (d.
